We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. Job Summary As a Support Automation Engineer on the Post Sales Systems team, you will design, build, and maintain the automation and AI systems that power ClickUp's post-sales support organization. You'll be responsible for translating business workflows in Zendesk and related CX platforms into scalable, intelligent automations that reduce manual effort, improve customer experience, and free up our support team to focus on high-value interactions. This role sits at the intersection of engineering rigor and customer empathy. You'll partner closely with the Support and Success organizations, GTM Systems Leadership, and cross-functional stakeholders to automate away toil, surface insights through AI, and build systems that adapt to how support teams actually work. The kind of person who thrives here moves fast, takes full ownership of what they build, and is genuinely excited about applying AI to real operational problems. This role is a direct contributor to GTMSOE's broader mission of operational excellence across the GTM org. Key Responsibilities AI-Powered Automation Design & Development Design and build automations in Zendesk that reduce repetitive support work: ticket routing, field population, note summarization, escalation logic, and customer outreach workflows. Develop AI-driven workflows using Zendesk AI, custom LLM integrations, and ClickUp Super Agents to automate tasks like ticket summarization, sentiment analysis, knowledge base matching, and response suggestions. Architect low-code/no-code automation solutions using Workato, Zapier, and similar integration platforms to connect Zendesk with Salesforce, ClickUp, Maven chatbot, and other tools. Own the full lifecycle of an automation: discovery, design, build, testing, deployment, and ongoing optimization based on usage and feedback. CX Systems Integration & Data Flow Ensure seamless data flow between Zendesk, Salesforce, ClickUp, Chili Piper, Maven AGI chatbot, and other tools in the support tech stack. Design integration patterns that keep data clean, up-to-date, and accessible to downstream systems without creating maintenance nightmares. Build and maintain reporting dashboards and data pipelines that surface support health, automation impact, and team productivity metrics. Partner with the Support org to identify pain points, bottlenecks, and opportunities where AI and automation can deliver measurable value. AI Capability Expansion Experiment with emerging AI/LLM capabilities (agents, RAG, fine-tuning) and determine which are production-ready for support workflows. Build reusable AI templates and patterns that other CX Systems team members can leverage, promoting consistency and reducing duplication. Collaborate with the broader GTM Systems Engineering team to share learnings and align on AI strategy across post-sales, sales, and finance domains. Log AI/automation work in the team's AI Excellence registry to promote transparency and cross-team learning. Reliability & Continuous Improvement Monitor automation health, error rates, and SLAs; proactively identify and resolve issues before they impact support operations. Gather feedback from support teams and stakeholders; iterate on existing automations to improve accuracy, reduce false positives, and adapt to evolving business needs. Maintain documentation and runbooks so that support and CX teams understand how automations work and when to escalate issues. Help simplify and modernize existing architecture in Zendesk and connecting systems to improve long-term maintainability. Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with GTM Support teammates and leadership on intake, prioritization, and task execution. Partner with the Support and Success organizations and key stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical specifications. Contribute to the GTM Systems Engineering operating model: maintain task hygiene and communicate proactively on large initiatives. Qualifications Experience 3–5+ years in systems administration, business systems engineering, or customer support platform work. Demonstrated experience building automations or integrations that have shipped to production and delivered measurable business value. Hands-on experience with CX platforms, particularly Zendesk at an admin level or higher. Experience in a high-velocity, collaborative environment where you wear multiple hats and adapt quickly. Optional but valued: experience with ClickUp, Maven/chatbots, GTM systems, or support-focused SaaS operations. Skills & Competencies Technical Zendesk expertise: Hands-on experience with automations, triggers, business rules, and configuration (admin-level proficiency or higher). Integration & API work: Comfortable with REST APIs, webhooks, and integration platforms (Retool, Workato, Zapier, or similar low-code tools). AI & LLMs: Familiarity with prompt engineering, LLM APIs (OpenAI, Claude, etc.), MCP, and how to safely integrate AI into production workflows. You don't need to be an ML engineer, but you should understand when and how to apply AI to solve real problems. Data & scripting: Comfortable working with JSON, SQL, or light scripting (Python, JavaScript) to build data pipelines and transform data between systems. Salesforce integration: Understanding of Zendesk-to-Salesforce sync workflows, object relationships, and common integration patterns. Operational & Mindset Ownership: You take full responsibility for the systems you build—reliability, documentation, and continuous improvement included. You don't hand off and walk away. Velocity: You move fast, iterate, and ship. You embrace "done is better than perfect" when appropriate, but never at the expense of reliability or customer trust. AI & Automation mindset: You're excited about LLMs and AI agents, not intimidated. You experiment, learn quickly, and know when to apply new tools and when to stick with what works. Collaboration: You're a skilled communicator who can translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders. You ask clarifying questions, challenge assumptions respectfully, and build trust with the teams you support. Growth: You're customer-centric and measure success not just by automation coverage, but by the real impact on support efficiency and quality. What You'll Work With Zendesk: Primary CX platform—automations, triggers, custom fields, custom apps, and reporting. ClickUp Super Agents: AI-powered automation and task orchestration within the ClickUp ecosystem. Salesforce: Zendesk-to-Salesforce integration, data sync, field mapping, and cross-system workflows. Integration stack: Workato, Zapier, and possibly Retool for custom apps and workflow orchestration. Maven chatbot & AI tools: In-app support, ticket automation, and AI-driven customer interactions. Data & reporting: ClickUp, Salesforce dashboards, and custom data pipelines for support metrics and insights. Equal Opportunity Employer ClickUp is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin. Privacy Notice ClickUp collects and processes personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws. You can find further details by viewing our Global Candidate Privacy Notice. If you are a Philippine Job Applicant, please also see our Philippine Data Privacy Notice for further details. Visa Sponsorship Please note we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for roles outside of engineering and product at this time. Sponsorship for engineering and product roles is not guaranteed, but is instead based on the business needs for that specific role at that time. Please reach out to the recruiter with any questions. Fraud Alert ClickUp Talent Acquisition will only initiate contact via an @ clickup.com email or through our official careers portal on clickup.com . We will never request fees, payments, or sensitive personal information. Please disregard any offers received outside these channels and report them to support@clickup.com. AI Processing Notice ClickUp may use artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies to help review and screen candidates' employment applications against role-related criteria. These tools support, but do not replace, human decision‑making. If you have questions or need an accommodation in the recruitment process, please contact us at AskPeople@ClickUp.com.

items.title: Data Analyst, Clinical Data Effectiveness
items.summary: Counterpart Health is an AI‑powered physician enablement platform that delivers clinical insights to providers at the point of care. Our flagship product, Counterpart Assistant, is embedded into clinicians’ workflows and integrates with EHR systems, helping care teams drive value-based outcomes, close care gaps, and proactively manage chronic disease. As we grow our data ecosystem, expanding…
items.description: Counterpart Health is an AI‑powered physician enablement platform that delivers clinical insights to providers at the point of care. Our flagship product, Counterpart Assistant, is embedded into clinicians’ workflows and integrates with EHR systems, helping care teams drive value-based outcomes, close care gaps, and proactively manage chronic disease. As we grow our data ecosystem, expanding across legacy interoperability networks, QHIN/TEFCA connectivity, and direct HIE integrations, we need rigorous analytical ownership to ensure the clinical data powering our platform is complete, reliable, and actionable. You will serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for clinical data completeness and effectiveness at Counterpart Health. Sitting within the Data Products pillar, this role owns the end-to-end understanding of our clinical data lifecycle: where data comes from, where it breaks down, and how each vendor or integration pathway performs across our customer markets. Your analysis will directly shape vendor strategy, facility targeting, and data pipeline investments, thus ensuring that the clinical evidence our care teams depend on is consistently available and trustworthy. As a Data Analyst, you will: Proactively identify and monitor which healthcare facilities consistently generate high-quality, usable clinical documents (e.g., EHRs, discharge summaries, procedure notes) to precisely locate and quantify data gaps. Conduct deep-dive analyses by mapping and correlating facility-specific data across disparate sources like structured claims, clinical care summaries (CCDAs), and ADT messages to uncover systematic patterns of missingness, latency, Experience with TEFCA/QHIN frameworks and evolving national interoperability standards. Familiarity with vendor-specific data exchange platforms (e.g., Bamboo Health, HSX, Particle Health, Kno2). Background in value-based care, population health, or clinical data operations. Experience with claims-clinical data reconciliation (e.g., matching EOBs to clinical encounter records). Comfort working with Python or similar tools for data manipulation and automation. or incongruence in clinical records. Establish and maintain clear, transparent reporting on ADT coverage across key geographic, organizational, and technological dimensions (e.g., by county, facility, and underlying EMR system). Based on rigorous analysis of data flow and quality, recommend and guide the implementation of optimal technical configurations for existing data vendors (e.g., Bamboo Health, PCC, Experian, HSX). Conduct comprehensive evaluations and proof-of-concepts for potential new data integration technologies (e.g., Kno2 vs. Particle Health) to assess viability, quality improvements, and strategic fit. Systematically determine the existence and completeness of documentation associated with specific patient visits or encounters. Develop a data-driven framework for prioritizing facility targets for direct data acquisition, assessing impact, cost-effectiveness, and technical feasibility. Inform and guide vendor strategy around national initiatives such as TEFCA and QHIN adoption, ensuring Counterpart Health is positioned for compliant, high-quality data exchange. Partner cross-functionally with Product Managers to define data requirements, Engineers to implement reliable pipelines, and Clinical teams to validate data quality and clinical utility. Act as a critical liaison to identify and remove operational and technical bottlenecks, ensuring a predictable, scalable, and reliable clinical data flow across all customer markets. You should get in touch if you have: 2+ years of hands-on data analytics experience, with direct exposure to healthcare data interoperability Strong hands-on experience with healthcare data standards: HL7, CCDA, and ADT messages. Proficiency in SQL and comfort working with large, complex datasets (claims, clinical logs, interoperability data). Background in analyzing interoperability networks (e.g., Carequality, CommonWell, eHealthExchange) or HIE integrations. Skilled at data visualization and able to present complex findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong investigative mindset, i.e., you enjoy digging into the “why” behind missing data and diverging metrics. Self-directed and able to manage multiple analytical projects (vendor comparisons, visit-level reconciliation) without constant supervision. Preferred Qualifications: Experience with TEFCA/QHIN frameworks and evolving national interoperability standards. Familiarity with vendor-specific data exchange platforms (e.g., Bamboo Health, HSX, Particle Health, Kno2). Background in value-based care, population health, or clinical data operations. Experience with claims-clinical data reconciliation (e.g., matching EOBs to clinical encounter records). Comfort working with Python or similar tools for data manipulation and automation. Benefits Overview : Financial Well-Being : Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions. Physical Well-Being : We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare. Mental Well-Being : We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location. Professional Development : Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews. Additional Perks: Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities Reimbursement for office setup expenses Monthly cell phone & internet stipend Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams Paid parental leave for all new parents And much more! About Counterpart Health: In 2018, Clover Health set out to do something unprecedented: build a clinically intuitive, AI-enabled solution that fits within physicians' workflows to help support the earlier diagnosis and management of chronic conditions. Years later, that vision is a reality, with thousands of practitioners using Counterpart Assistant during patient visits to improve disease management, reduce medical expenses, and drive success in value-based care. With an exceptional team of value-based care and technology experts, Counterpart Health is driving value-based care at the speed of software. Counterpart Health is a subsidiary of Clover Health. From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility. #LI-REMOTE Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We are an E-Verify company. Final pay is based on several factors including but not limited to internal equity, market data, and the applicant’s education, work experience, certifications, etc. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is: $77,000—$100,000 USD

items.title: Community Experience Lead
items.summary: The ALX Community Experience team is a high-performing, impact-driven team that thrives on collaboration and scale.
items.description: The ALX Community Experience team is a high-performing, impact-driven team that thrives on collaboration and scale. We embrace innovation, test new ideas, and go the extra mile to deliver meaningful results and experiences for our Learners and Alumni. Grounded in data and fueled by solutions, we hold ourselves and each other accountable to exceptionally high standards, enabling us to consistently grow and strengthen the ALX Community across markets. Do you excel in fast-paced environments where ambitious goals drive your work? Do you bring an analytical mindset that helps you identify trends, improve systems, and translate insights into action? Are you a natural relationship-builder who can foster trust and collaboration across regions and teams? Are you ready to roll up your sleeves, adapt quickly, and do whatever it takes to ensure the success of our Community? If so, then this could be the role for you. About ALX Africa ALX Africa, a non-profit organisation under the ALX Foundation, is dedicated to unlocking the potential of Africa's digital future. Formerly part of Sand Tech Holdings, we've embarked on an independent journey to provide world-class tech skills training and career acceleration programmes. Our mission is to bridge the digital divide, upskill and re-skill talent, and create a generation of innovative leaders. By 2030, we aim to empower 2 million Africans to secure sustainable tech careers. With hubs in 8 cities across Africa and counting, we provide safe access to quality learning and a dedicated network of expert instructors. Our innovative programmes equip learners with the practical skills and knowledge needed to succeed in today's rapidly evolving tech industry. Through a combination of rigorous coursework, industry partnerships, and hands-on projects, we prepare our students for in-demand roles in software engineering, data science, and cybersecurity. We achieve this by: Providing young professionals with access to the most in-demand tech skills that will power the future. Empowering the next generation of technology innovators, entrepreneurs, and business leaders through challenging, real-world coursework. Building a lifelong, impactful Community of tech professionals that support them at all stages of their career journey. Our impact thus far: 347k+ graduates since 2020 257k youth in work 31k youth starting own ventures 60k youth in jobs created by entrepreneurs Visit our website to learn more about our digital revolution. Role Summary As the Community Experience Lead, you will own the long-term vision and strategy for Community across ALX, ensuring it is embedded throughout the entire talent journey, from selection and recruitment through learning, transition, and lifelong alumni engagement. You will lead a small, high-performing team, currently a Community Program Specialist and a Community Operations Associate, setting direction, unblocking execution, and developing their capability. You will represent Community experience at the leadership table: aligning goals with broader organisational priorities, managing relationships with cross-functional stakeholders (Brand, Alumni Relations, Product, Regional teams, and more), and reporting on Community performance and impact to drive continued investment in the function. Specific Responsibilities Strategy & Vision Define and drive the long-term Community Experience strategy, ensuring it stays member-led, city-driven, and embedded across the full talent lifecycle, from marketing to lifelong engagement. Set the roadmap for major strategic initiatives (e.g. unifying the Learner and Alumni community, engagement tracking, ambassador programs, resource and knowledge hubs) and prioritise investment across them. Translate organisational goals into a clear Community roadmap, and adjust strategy as the business, budget, and community needs evolve . Champion what Community is and isn't: a decentralised, member-led function that advises, curates, and enables rather than dictates, and that lives throughout the talent journey rather than as a stand-alone function. Team Leadership & People Management Manage and develop the Community Program Specialist and Community Operations Associate, setting clear goals, giving regular feedback, and supporting their growth. Model and reinforce a high-performance, high-accountability team culture grounded in data and continuous improvement. Conduct regular 1:1s and performance reviews, identify development and growth opportunities, and manage performance issues directly and fairly. Recruit , onboard, and scale the Community team as the function grows, defining roles and hiring needs in line with the strategy. Unblock the team's day-to-day execution: resolving cross-functional dependencies, prioritisation conflicts, and resourcing gaps before they stall delivery. Extend leadership beyond direct reports by supporting and coaching City-based Community Managers and Ambassadors on standards, tools, and ways of working. Stakeholder Management Act as the primary point of contact and central voice for Community-related initiatives across the organisation. Build and maintain strong relationships with cross-functional teams, including Loyalty & Rewards, Alumni Relations, Regional/City teams, Brand, Product, and Learning Delivery, aligning on shared goals and initiatives. Represent the Community function in leadership and planning conversations, securing buy-in and resourcing for Community priorities. Proactively surface and manage risks such as community outreach fatigue, ensuring member-facing communication stays coordinated across teams. Negotiate priorities and trade-offs with other functions when their goals compete for member attention, time, or Community team capacity. Build a network of relationships with Leads and Regional teams to keep the central strategy grounded in local, on-the-ground realities. Reporting & Performance Own reporting on Community engagement, member satisfaction, and program impact to senior stakeholders, using data to make the case for continued investment. Track team and program performance against goals, identifying trends and opportunities for continuous improvement. Run regular business reviews on Community performance, translating metrics into a clear narrative of impact, risk, and recommended next steps. Own the Community experience function's budget: forecasting costs, tracking spend against plan, and prioritising investment when resources are constrained. Benchmark ALX's Community engagement and practices against comparable organisations, feeding external insight back into strategy. Skill Requirements-Must Have 5+ years of experience in community management, program or operations management, or a related field, with at least 2 years in a people-management or team-lead capacity, ideally in education, tech, or a membership-based organisation. Proven experience setting strategy and translating it into an executable roadmap across a small team. Track record of managing and developing direct reports, including goal-setting, feedback, and coaching. Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience influencing cross-functional partners and senior leadership without direct authority. Comfortable owning, reporting, and KPIs: defining metrics, tracking performance, and communicating impact to non-technical audiences. Hands-on understanding of online community platforms (e.g. Discourse, Circle, Slack, Discord, or similar) and member communications (newsletters, email tools such as Mailchimp or HubSpot). Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to represent Community's voice and priorities across the organisation. Ability to operate at both the strategic and operational levels, moving comfortably between long-term planning and day-to-day problem solving. Ability to work with cross-functional teams across multiple locations and time zones, including virtually. Skill Requirements - Nice To Have Passion for community growth, collaboration, and creating meaningful connections. Experience building or scaling a community-led growth, ambassador, or referral program. Experience with data visualization or engagement analytics tools (e.g. Tableau, Power BI, or similar). Background in budget management or making the business case for program investment. Knowledge of behavioural psychology or engagement strategies to improve retention and participation. Experience operating in a multi-market, distributed organisation. Employment Type This role is a Full-time position. As this is a fully remote role, the successful applicant should be highly self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working in a digital-first environment. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams using tools such as Zoom, Slack, and Gmail. Strong communication is essential, and success in this role will depend on your ability to stay connected, work proactively, and take initiative. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Manager, Business Performance & Analysis
items.summary: ABOUT ALUALU provides higher education for a higher purpose.
items.description: ABOUT ALU ALU provides higher education for a higher purpose. Our students declare missions, not majors.They develop the real-world skills to take on the world’s most pressing challenges. And they take ownership of their learning from day one through our peer and student-led approach – because ALU believes in the power and agency of young people to start shaping the future right now. Together with a world-class faculty and staff, our students are igniting a ripple of positive impact across Africa and the world. We are dedicated to fostering an open yet secure environment, balancing the safety of students, staff, and visitors with respect for individual rights, and safeguarding responsibilities. HOW WE WORK The ALU Team works in starkly different ways to traditional academic bureaucracies. We approach education from first principles, empower individuals to design, test, and implement creative new ideas, and work closely together to craft transformative learning experiences. We are deeply passionate about our students and excited by the challenge of building something entirely new. The African Leadership University is committed to ensuring the safety and Well-being of all students under our care. As part of this commitment , we have a comprehensive safeguarding policy in place , which outlines our Zero-tolerance approach to any violation of safeguarding. ABOUT THE TEAM The Business Performance & Analysis team is one of ALU ’s core performance intelligence functions, providing the insight, analysis and challenge required to help leaders understand performance, make informed decisions and improve institutional outcomes. Working across academic and professional functions, the team goes beyond reporting what has happened to understand why it happened, what it means, what is likely to happen next, and what action is required. It brings together performance data, analysis and external benchmarks to identify trends, risks, opportunities and areas for improvement. The team connects strategy, performance and execution by strengthening performance measurement, supporting decision-making and helping leaders translate insight into action. Its impact is measured not by the volume of reports produced, but by the quality of decisions informed and the improvements in institutional performance that follow. ABOUT THE ROLE The institution generates a great deal of information and data across campuses, programmes and systems held by functions with different definitions and different reporting rhythms. The Manager, Business Performance & Analysis will assemble it, identify what matters in it and put that in front of the people who have to decide. You are expected to find the insight inside fragmented institutional information and make it usable by the people who have to act on it. This role goes beyond producing analysis to deciding what the analysis means, what can reasonably be concluded from it, and the form in which that meaning will actually land. The role will enable the University to act on what its own information is telling it by bringing together fragmented evidence, establishing what matters and putting it in front of the right person in a form they can use. ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES Research, Economic Analysis and Insight (the core of the role) Produce quantitative and economic analysis underpinning material submitted to the Executive Committee and the Board including scenario work, unit economics, capacity and cost modelling, cost behaviour, and the baseline scenario against which a decision should be judged. Take fragmentary, inconsistent and incomplete inputs from several functions and produce one defensible view, with the areas of remaining uncertainty named rather than smoothed over. This is the central skill of the role. Interrogate the question behind the request. Where the question as asked will not produce a useful answer, clarify the decision that needs to be supported and propose the more useful analytical question. Maintain relevant external evidence, including comparator institutions, sector benchmarks, published research and precedent relevant to current analyses and decisions. Build and maintain the external evidence base: comparator institutions, sector benchmarks, published research, and precedent relevant to decisions in front of ALU . State assumptions explicitly, and state plainly what an analysis does not establish. Where required data does not exist, publish the gap rather than substituting a proxy without saying so. Review recurring analysis and underlying assumptions, identify material gaps or inconsistencies, and raise findings where further scrutiny is required. Communication and Decision-Ready Output Design data and insight presentations so the key finding is immediately visible rather than presenting the dataset in full. Treat chart selection, sequencing and emphasis as analytical choices. Determine the appropriate format for each piece of work, whether a written memo, one-page decision brief, chart, dashboard, model walkthrough or verbal briefing, based on the decision, audience and complexity involved. Write for senior readers with limited time: lead with the finding or decision required, support it with the relevant evidence, and state what remains unknown and what would resolve it. Adjust the level of detail, language and presentation across audiences including the Executive Committee, Board, departmental leaders and technical counterparts. Present analysis clearly and confidently, including the assumptions, limitations and implications of the work. Automation and tooling Support the development and maintenance of automated workflows for data extraction, reconciliation, monitoring and reporting, reducing recurring manual effort. Use AI-enabled tools, agents and scripted workflows to accelerate recurring analytical tasks, including drafting, summarisation, exception detection, data preparation and scheduled checks. Apply judgement to AI-generated outputs, validate results and identify where automation should not replace human review. Build and maintain escalation triggers within recurring analytical and monitoring processes so that exceptions, overdue actions or material changes generate timely alerts. Document analytical tools and workflows to a standard that allows another team member to operate, understand and modify them without reliance on the original author. Analytics Capability and Continuous Improvement Improve analytical methodologies, templates, reporting processes and tools used by the Business Performance & Analysis function. Identify recurring requests and manual processes that can be standardised, automated or redesigned. Establish practical quality checks for recurring analysis and reporting. Share analytical methods, tools and lessons learned across the team and support the development of analytical capability. Performance Tracking and Follow-through Maintain accurate records of key decisions, actions, owners, assumptions and review dates arising from performance and planning activities. Monitor agreed actions and escalation triggers and raise overdue or off-track items appropriately through appropriate and well suited digital tools. Maintain the document repository to support continuity, transparency and effective handover. Executive and cycle coordination Coordinate engagement requirements against the University's planning, review and reporting calendar, including committee dates, planning cycles, statutory requirements and reporting deadlines. Prepare the analysis, briefing material and supporting information required for those engagements. Track actions and commitments arising from key meetings and ensure they are reflected in the appropriate working records and follow-up mechanisms. Coordinate inputs across functions to ensure materials are complete, consistent and ready for review. Ensure the safety and well-being of all young persons and vulnerable adults with whom we deal, by adhering to ALU ’s comprehensive safeguarding policy, maintaining a zero-tolerance approach to any violations of safeguarding standards REQUIRED EXPERIENCE 6 to 8 years of relevant professional experience, with demonstrated experience producing analysis that informs decisions taken by people more senior than yourself, in a research institution, consultancy, financial institution, policy body, university, or comparable analytical function. Economic reasoning, evidenced by training or by practice. You think in terms of opportunity cost, marginal effects, incentives and counterfactuals, and you state your assumptions before your conclusions. A degree in economics or experience across consulting, policy research, financial analysis or a quantitative discipline. Demonstrated ability to turn complex analysis into concise executive communication, including decision briefs, presentations, dashboards or written recommendations. Working competence in Python or R for data analysis and evidence of having built or supported an analytical workflow that can run with limited manual intervention. Practical experience using AI-enabled tools, including large language models, agents or scripted workflows, to improve analytical productivity, automation or decision support. Demonstrated ability to take incomplete and conflicting inputs from multiple sources and produce a single defensible view. Demonstrated ability to become productive quickly in an unfamiliar subject area and build sufficient domain understanding to analyse it effectively. Experience working across functions with different data sources, priorities and perspectives is strongly preferred. Exposure to executive, Board or committee reporting is desirable. REQUIRED COMPETENCIES Functional Competencies Analytical Reasoning: Break down complex questions, identify the relevant variables and determine the analysis required to support a decision. Data Interpretation and Judgement: Analyse information critically, identify patterns and anomalies, test assumptions and assess what can reasonably be concluded. Economic and Financial Acumen: Understand opportunity cost, incentives, cost behaviour, revenue, contribution and the financial implications of decisions. Modelling and Forecasting: Build and interpret scenarios, forecasts and sensitivity analyses to support planning and decision-making. Digital and AI Fluency: Use analytical, automation and AI-enabled tools confidently to improve speed and quality while independently validating outputs. Executive Communication: Distil complex analysis into clear findings, implications and recommendations appropriate to the audience and decision required. Behavioural & Leadership Competencies Judgement: Recognise what matters, make sound calls with imperfect information and know when further analysis is warranted. Constructive Challenge: Question assumptions, identify weaknesses and raise material concerns directly and objectively. Ownership: Take responsibility for analytical quality, timeliness and usefulness from problem definition through to delivery. Collaboration: Work effectively across Finance, Data/IT, academic and professional functions while respecting ownership of underlying data and business processes. Delivery Discipline: Manage competing demands, coordinate contributors and deliver high-quality work to agreed timelines. Continuous Improvement: Improve processes, tools and ways of working so that recurring work becomes more efficient, reliable and scalable. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Data Analyst, Growth & Monetization - ChessKid
items.summary: About Us Chess. com is one of the largest gaming sites in the world and the #1 platform for playing, learning, and enjoying chess.
items.description: About Us Chess.com is one of the largest gaming sites in the world and the #1 platform for playing, learning, and enjoying chess. We are a team of 600+ fully remote people in 60+ countries working hard to serve the global chess community. We are here to support 200M+ chess players worldwide with the best possible product, content, and tools to serve the community We are a tech company. A gaming company. A content company. And we do it all with passion and commitment to the game. Above all we prize our mission-driven, flat, life-celebrating, no-corporate culture, and we look forward to meeting you and learning more about what you can bring to the team. is the world’s #1 chess site for kids and the scholastic extension of Chess.com . ChessKid is fun, educational, and dedicated to being a safe place for kids to learn and play chess. ChessKid stats (as of Dec. 2025) 12M+ Happy Kids on the platform 31K+ Schools use ChessKid 97M+ Games played on ChessKid 118M+ Puzzles Solved 17M+ Lessons taken About You You are an analytic thinker with a passion for driving product innovation and business growth through data-driven insights. With experience in consumer software and/or gaming analytics and funnels, you are adept at navigating data to extract meaningful insights on user retention, engagement, monetization, and product interaction. You have the product and business knowledge to serve a diverse set of stakeholders, and can also proactively produce insights that get our teams working on the right thing, faster. Your analytical skills are matched by a strategic mindset and an ability to communicate insights in a simple and compelling way. What you'll do Help define and document our event taxonomy, and work directly with product teams to define new events that are consistent with our overarching event structure and taxonomy Dive into our data to discover insights on player behavior across different cohorts, segments, and stages of the user lifecycle, and communicate/collect feedback on your findings from peers, business, and product partners Work with business, product, and engineering teams to [plan → design → ship → evaluate] experiments/AB-Tests, and communicate their results/impact with the company. items.description: About the Role As a Project Associate, you’ll manage the processes that prepare contributors for AI, LLM, data collection, and relevance projects. You’ll build and maintain onboarding workflows, learning materials, and readiness reporting while evaluating contributor performance to ensure they are prepared to begin work. You’ll partner with Recruiting, Trust & Safety, Delivery, and Program teams to ensure onboarding programs are ready for launch, aligned with project requirements, and continuously improved. Your Impact Set up workflows, launch materials, and supporting content for new and expanding projects. Create and maintain clear enablement materials, including modules, FAQs, exercises, quizzes, and knowledge checks. Evaluate contributor qualifications and eligibility, maintain records, and manage access and task assignments within project tools. Respond to contributor questions and tickets related to onboarding and access, escalating issues when needed. Maintain trackers and dashboards, provide project updates, and flag inconsistencies or risks affecting contributor readiness. Analyze onboarding and performance issues, identify root causes, and develop targeted clarifications or refresher content. Success in this role means contributors are prepared on time, project quality standards are met, and stakeholders have clear visibility into readiness and performance. What You Bring 2–3 years of experience in a metric-driven environment such as operations, production, or a customer support/call center setting. Moderate to advanced Excel and Power BI or equivalent dashboarding experience, with the ability to build and maintain trackers and readiness reporting. Familiarity with AI concepts and terminology, including LLMs, prompting, annotation, and search relevance. Experience working with ticketing or contributor/crowd support platforms. Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain policies and guidelines to diverse audiences. Flexibility to support changing program needs and work a night shift schedule. Preferred Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience. Project Management, data analytics or process improvement. Compensation Additional Information Why You'll Love Working Here At Appen, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence. We value curiosity, accountability, and a commitment to delivering the highest quality AI solutions for frontier models. You'll work on complex challenges that shape the future of AI across industries and geographies, alongside talented people in a culture that values humility over ego. You'll have the flexibility to deliver in a way that works for you and your team, supported by tools, resources, and development opportunities to continue to build your capability over time. About Appen Appen has been a leader in AI training data for over 30 years. We specialise in human generated data to train, fine tune, and evaluate models across generative AI, large language models, computer vision, and speech recognition. Our AI assisted data annotation platform and global crowd of more than 1 million contributors in over 200 countries support model pre training, supervised fine tuning, evaluation and benchmarking, safety and red teaming, and multilingual global expansion.

items.description: Data and Analytics Why USAA? At USAA, our mission is to empower our members to achieve financial security through highly competitive products, exceptional service and trusted advice. We seek to be the #1 choice for the military community and their families. Embrace a fulfilling career at USAA, where our core values – honesty, integrity, loyalty and service – define how we treat each other and our members. Be part of what truly makes us special and impactful. We are proud to support active-duty military spouses. USAA roles may offer remote or hybrid flexibility for active-duty military spouses consistent with applicable policy and business needs. The Opportunity This role is remote eligible in the continental U.S. with occasional business travel. However, individuals residing within a 60-mile radius of a USAA office will be expected to work on-site four days per week. Relocation assistance is not available for this position. Job Description The Lead Graph Data Scientist - Identity Analytics is responsible for development and implementing quantitative solutions that improve USAA's ability to detect and prevent identity theft, account takeover, and first-party/synthetic fraud. These solutions range from machine learning model development to enterprise deployment of graph analytics capabilities that protect USAA and our Members from these threats. Strong candidates will be able to deliver the following work products and processes: Develop and continuously update internal identity theft and authentication models to mitigate fraud losses and reduce negative member experience from fraud applications, synthetic fraud, and account takeover attempts Closely partner with the Strategy team, Director of Fraud Identity Analytics, Director of Fraud Model Management, and model users on model builds and priorities. Partner with Technology and other key collaborators to deploy a Member Protection graph technology strategy, including vendor selection, business requirements, data needs, and clear use cases spanning financial crimes Deploy graph databases and graph techniques to identify criminal networks engaging in fraud, scams, disputes/claims, and AML, improving fraud detection and loss mitigation Generate and prioritize fraud-dense rings to mitigate losses and improve Member experience Identify and work with technology to integrate new data sources for models and graphs to augment predictive power and improve business performance Exports insights to decision systems to enable better fraud targeting and model development efforts Drives continuous innovation in modeling efforts including advanced techniques like graph neural networks Develops and mentors junior staff, establishing a culture of R&D to augment the day-to-day aspects of the job What you'll do: Gathers, interprets, and manipulates sophisticated structured and unstructured data to enable sophisticated analytical solutions for the business. Leads and conducts sophisticated analytics demonstrating machine learning, simulation, and optimization to deliver business insights and achieve business objectives. Guides the team selecting the appropriate modeling technique and/or technology with consideration for data limitations, application, and business needs. Develops and deploys models within the Model Development Control (MDC) and Model Risk Management (MRM) framework. Composes and peer reviews technical documents for knowledge persistence, risk management, and technical review audiences. Partners with business leaders from across the organization to proactively identify business needs and propose/recommend analytical and modeling projects to generate business value. Works with business and analytics leaders to prioritize analytics and highly sophisticated modeling problems/research initiatives. Leads efforts to build and maintain a robust library of reusable, production-quality algorithms and supporting code to ensure model development and research efforts are transparent and based on highest-quality data. Assists the team with translating business request(s) into specific analytical questions, implementing analysis and/or modeling, and communicating outcomes to non-technical business colleagues with a focus on business action and recommendations. Manages project portfolio milestones, risks, and impediments. Anticipates potential issues that could limit project success or implementation and escalates as needed. Establishes and maintains standard methodologies for engaging with Data Engineering and IT to deploy production-ready analytical assets consistent with modeling best practices and model risk management standards. Interacts with internal and external peers and management to maintain expertise and awareness of leading techniques. Actively seeks opportunities and materials to learn new techniques, technologies, and methodologies. Serves as a mentor to data scientists in modeling, analytics, computer science, business acumen, and other interpersonal skills. Participates in enterprise-level efforts to drive the maintenance and transformation of data science technologies and culture. Ensures risks associated with business activities are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures. What you have: Bachelor's degree in mathematics, computer science, statistics, economics, finance, actuarial sciences, science and engineering, or other similar quantitative field; OR 4 years of experience in statistics, mathematics, quantitative analytics, or related experience (in addition to the minimum years of experience required) may be substituted in lieu of degree. 8 years of experience in predictive analytics or data analysis 6 years of experience in training and validating statistical, physical, machine learning, and other advanced analytics models. 4 years of experience in one or more dynamic scripted languages (such as Python, R, etc.) for performing statistical analyses and/or building and scoring AI/ML models. Expert ability to write code that is easy to follow, well documented, and commented where necessary to explain logic (high code transparency). Strong experience in querying and preprocessing data from structured and/or unstructured databases using query languages such as SQL, NoSQL, etc. Strong experience in working with structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data files such as delimited numeric data files, JSON/XML files, and/or text documents, images, etc. Excellent demonstrated skill in performing ad-hoc analytics using descriptive, diagnostic, and inferential statistics. Proven ability to assess and articulate regulatory implications and expectations of distinct modeling efforts. Project management experience that demonstrates the ability to anticipate and appropriately manage project milestones, risks, and impediments. Demonstrated history of appropriately communicating potential issues that could limit project success or implementation. Expert level experience with the concepts and technologies associated with classical supervised modeling for prediction such as linear/logistic models, discriminant analysis, support vector machines, decision trees, and ensemble methods such as Random Forests, XGBoost, LightGBM, and CatBoost. Expert level experience with the concepts and technologies associated with unsupervised modeling such as k-means clustering, hierarchical/agglomerative clustering, nearest-neighbors algorithms, DBSCAN, etc. Demonstrated experience in guiding and mentoring junior technical staff in business interactions and model building. Demonstrated ability to communicate ideas with team members and/or business leaders to convey and present very technical information to an audience that may have little or no understanding of technical concepts in data science. A strong track record of communicating results, insights, and technical solutions to senior executive management (or equivalent). Extensive technical skills, consulting experience, and business savvy to collaborate with all levels and subject areas within the organization. items.description: Location: London, UK (Hybrid or Fully Remote within the UK), unfortunately we cannot support VISA + relocation for this role. The multi-Oscar-winning creative Film & Episodic Studio at Framestore has worked with some of the greatest storytellers in film today. Collaborating with directors and producers across the complete filmmaking process to help design, plan and create beautiful images, we focus on finding innovative creative solutions to support their vision and set new standards for visual effects in cinema. Framestore combines talent and technology to bring life to everything we create. Driven by creativity and inspired by the future, we set out every day to reframe the possible. About the role This is a new role within our team. As a Senior Pipeline Technical Director for Film 2D, you'll play a central role in building a resilient, intelligent VFX pipeline that removes technical friction and keeps our artists focused on creative delivery. You'll focus on supporting and enhancing production workflows across our 2D division, covering Compositing, Paint & Roto, Editorial, and Review Tools. From building robust Python tools to pioneering practical machine learning integrations (such as Switchlight, SAM3, and ComfyUI workflows), you'll help automate complex tasks and streamline shot delivery. Working closely with artist supervisors, heads of department, and our global pipeline team across London, Montreal, Melbourne, and Mumbai, you'll combine strong software engineering practices with a grounded, production-focused approach. What you’ll do Develop, test, and maintain artist-friendly Python and PySide tools across our 2D workflows. Integrate practical machine learning solutions into our active pipeline to automate complex tasks and accelerate shot delivery. Collaborate closely with Compositing Supervisors, VFX Supervisors, and Heads of 2D to proactively identify and resolve workflow bottlenecks. Maintain and expand core software libraries, ensuring clean code, Git version control, and clear documentation. Support and enhance deep Nuke API integrations, custom gizmos, and media processing workflows. Offer technical guidance, share best practices, and mentor junior team members across our global department. What we’re looking for Significant experience in VFX pipeline development with a solid understanding of 2D production workflows. Expert Python development skills, with a focus on modern design patterns, clean code, and standard libraries. Strong experience building custom GUI applications and tools using PySide or PyQt. Deep experience with the Nuke API, programmatic control, and workflow automation. Practical experience deploying machine learning models directly into production pipelines. Solid understanding of open-source VFX frameworks such as OpenImageIO, OpenColorIO, FFmpeg, and OpenRV. Strong software engineering fundamentals in a Linux environment, including Git, code reviews, testing, and performance monitoring. Approachable communication skills and a user-centric mindset when building tools for artists. You might also have Hands-on experience with ComfyUI or Stable Diffusion for custom generative AI pipelines and node development. Containerisation experience (Docker or similar) for deploying scalable machine learning inference services. Experience with render farm queue managers such as Deadline or Tractor. Web development skills using FastAPI, React, or similar for building pipeline dashboards. Experience setting up CI/CD workflows in GitLab. Scripting experience with ShotGrid / Flow Production Tracking APIs and database handling (SQL/NoSQL). Experience guiding agentic AI workflows to design and construct scalable, well-architected solutions. Prior hands-on experience as a 2D Compositor. Accessibility Statement Our London studio is fully accessible, with step-free entry, accessible toilets on all floors, and quiet spaces available. We are committed to supporting disabled colleagues and providing an inclusive workplace for everyone. items.description: Software Engineering Job Requisition ID # 25WD93193 English posting follows 25WD93193 Architecte logiciel, Plateforme de données AEC Aperçu du poste Chez Autodesk, nous sommes des pionniers dans le domaine des logiciels de conception 3D, d'ingénierie et de divertissement. Nous développons des outils qui permettent à certains des esprits les plus créatifs de la planète de résoudre des problèmes concrets. Reconnus par Fortune, Forbes, Glassdoor et d'autres comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs, nous nous engageons à créer un milieu de travail diversifié et inclusif où l'innovation et la créativité s'épanouissent. L'organisation Autodesk chargée des données en architecture, ingénierie et construction (AEC) est à la recherche d'un architecte logiciel expérimenté pour se joindre à l'équipe AEC Data et définir les services natifs du nuage ainsi que l'architecture des systèmes distribués qui sous-tendent le modèle de données AEC (AECDM) et les nombreux services qui l'entourent. Bien que le domaine soit celui des données, ce poste relève fondamentalement de l'architecture du nuage et des services - API, contrats de service, intégrations, conception de systèmes distribués et modèle de données connecté qui les relie entre eux - et s'étend à plusieurs équipes. Il ne s'agit pas d'un poste de spécialiste en entrepôt de données ou en analyse de données. L'organisation AEC Data met en place l'infrastructure de données fondamentale qui sous-tend la vision d'Autodesk en matière de construction connectée : les plateformes, les services et les modèles de données unifiés qui couvrent l'ensemble du cycle de vie des actifs bâtis, de la conception et de la construction jusqu'à l'exploitation et à l'entretien. Ce travail permet la circulation continue des données AEC (modèles 3D, dessins 2D, suivi des problèmes, coûts, flux de capteurs, etc.) entre les produits Autodesk et les intégrations tierces. L'architecte contribuera à façonner la prochaine génération de fonctionnalités pour le nuage industriel Autodesk Forma, en collaborant avec des architectes logiciels, des experts du domaine et les équipes de produit de Revit, Civil 3D, AutoCAD, Autodesk Construction Cloud et Autodesk Forma. Il s'agit d'un poste de contributeur senior dans un parcours d'architecture bien établi, relevant de l'architecte émérite de l'équipe AEC Data, qui occupe également le poste d'architecte logiciel principal. La responsabilité principale consiste à définir la manière dont plusieurs équipes conçoivent et développent - par le biais de normes, d'architectures de référence, d'ADR et de la gouvernance de la révision de conception - plutôt que de gérer un service unique. L'orientation précise du poste s'adapte aux points forts du candidat et aux besoins de l'organisation. Responsabilités Conception et évolution des API : Concevoir et faire évoluer les interfaces API des services AEC Data - modélisation des ressources, adressage, gestion des versions et évolution rétrocompatible, API de requête, et unification des interfaces qui se chevauchent en un seul contrat cohérent Architecture système : Définir et faire évoluer une architecture inter-équipes et native du nuage pour l'ensemble des services AEC Data; concevoir des systèmes distribués, y compris les contrats de service et les flux pilotés par les événements Conception et évolution des schémas : Concevoir, documenter et faire évoluer les schémas de données pour les entités du domaine AEC (bâtiments, infrastructures, espaces, systèmes, composantes, relations) - y compris les modèles sémantiques, les ensembles de propriétés, les systèmes de classification et les hiérarchies de relations. Assurer la gestion des versions, de la compatibilité ascendante et descendante, de la dépréciation et de la migration; maintenir le registre des schémas, les règles de validation et les contrôles de qualité Normes et gouvernance : Établir des normes, des architectures de référence et des composantes réutilisables; rédiger des propositions d'architecture et des comptes rendus de décision (ADR) pour examen par un conseil d'architecture interorganisationnel, et mener des revues de conception interéquipes Prototypage et faisabilité : Évaluer différentes orientations architecturales par la modélisation et le prototypage, afin de réduire les risques liés aux décisions clés avant leur adoption à grande échelle Mentorat et leadership technique : Encadrer les développeurs et les autres architectes sur les technologies émergentes et établies ainsi que sur les pratiques architecturales; approfondir les compétences techniques au sein des équipes Fiabilité et performance : Assurer la fiabilité, la sécurité et la performance des systèmes; définir les SLO et favoriser l'observabilité (métriques, traçage, journalisation) Communication : Communiquer sur l'architecture à l'aide de vues et de diagrammes clairs (p. ex., C4) ainsi que de présentations adaptées à la haute direction; produire une documentation exhaustive et du matériel d'intégration Qualifications Minimales Baccalauréat en informatique, ou expérience équivalente Au moins 10 ans d'expérience dans la conception de systèmes distribués natifs du nuage, dont au moins 5 ans à un niveau d'architecte inter-équipes (architecte logiciel, développeur principal, Staff+ ou équivalent). Le titre est flexible; l'étendue de l'impact est le critère principal Expertise approfondie des services en nuage (de préférence AWS), de la conception d'API et de services, ainsi que des modèles de systèmes distribués (microservices, architecture orientée événements, résilience) Solides bases en modélisation de données et en conception de schémas - y compris les langages de définition de schémas (p. ex., JSON Schema), la gestion des versions, ainsi que la compatibilité ascendante et descendante et les stratégies d'évolution - telles qu'appliquées tant aux schémas de données autonomes qu'aux contrats d'API. Une spécialisation en architecture d'entrepôt de données ou d'analyse n'est pas requise Excellente connaissance de la conception logicielle et des modèles d'architecture Capacité démontrée à exercer une influence sans autorité hiérarchique et à favoriser la coordination entre les équipes ne relevant pas de la gestion directe du candidat Solides compétences en leadership et en mentorat, avec une expérience avérée dans l'encadrement et le développement d'équipes diversifiées et interfonctionnelles Maîtrise de la communication d'idées complexes de manière concise et convaincante, avec d'excellentes compétences verbales, écrites et de présentation auprès d'un large éventail de parties prenantes Capacité à collaborer avec une équipe internationale Qualifications Souhaitées Les qualifications souhaitées constituent un éventail de compétences plutôt qu'une liste de critères à cocher : une expertise approfondie dans quelques domaines clés importe davantage qu'une connaissance superficielle de l'ensemble d'entre eux. Les compétences émergentes en IA/apprentissage automatique (IA/ML) énumérées ci-dessous constituent un atout et peuvent être développées en cours d'emploi; elles ne sont pas des conditions préalables. Domaines clés Services en nuage : AWS et ses services clés (EC2, ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, RDS) Systèmes distribués : décomposition des services orientée domaine, modèles de cohérence des données (CQRS, event sourcing, sagas) et conception multi-locataires/multi-régions Conception d'API et de services : conception et évolution des API REST; GraphQL (y compris la fédération) Architecture de bases de données : relationnelles et NoSQL (p. ex., DynamoDB, PostgreSQL) Observabilité/SRE : OpenTelemetry, traçage distribué, métriques/SLO pour les services de données Bonus Technologies sémantiques : graphes de connaissances, RDF/OWL ou graphes de propriétés - particulièrement pertinents pour l'AECDM connecté/sémantique Expertise BIM : concepts de modélisation de l'information du bâtiment (BIM), familles Revit ou systèmes de modélisation paramétrique similaires Systèmes d'IA : RAG, agents/MCP, orchestration agentique (LangGraph, Semantic Kernel), observabilité des grands modèles de langage (LLM), et gouvernance des données / sécurité de l'IA (renseignements personnels identifiables [PII], injection de prompts, filtrage de contenu) IA spécifique au domaine de l'AEC : extraction BIM/IFC, traitement CAO ou de nuages de points B Architectures orientées événements B : Kafka ou Kinesis; registres de schémas (Confluent, AWS Glue); traitement exactly-once Connaissance du secteur de l'AEC : Expérience dans le secteur de l'architecture, de l'ingénierie et de la construction; connaissance des normes de l'industrie (IFC, COBie, gbXML, CityGML, LandXML, UniFormat, OmniClass). Une formation d'intégration au secteur est offerte ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 25WD93193 Software Architect, AEC Platform Data Position Overview At Autodesk, we are pioneers in 3D design, engineering, and entertainment software, building tools that empower some of the most creative minds on the planet to solve real-world problems. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Glassdoor, and others as a top place to work, we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where innovation and creativity thrive. Autodesk's Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) Data organization is seeking an experienced Software Architect to join the AEC Data team and define the cloud-native services and distributed-systems architecture that power the AEC Data Model (AECDM) and the many services around it. Data is the domain, but the role is fundamentally one of cloud and services architecture - APIs, service contracts, integrations, distributed-systems design, and the connected data model that ties them together - spanning multiple teams. It is not a data-warehouse or analytics-specialist role. The AEC Data organization is building the foundational data infrastructure behind Autodesk's vision for connected construction: the platforms, services, and unified data models that span the entire built-asset lifecycle, from design and construction through operation and maintenance. This work enables the continuous flow of AEC data (3D models, 2D drawings, issue tracking, cost, sensor streams, and more) across Autodesk products and third-party integrations. The architect will help shape the next generation of capabilities for the Autodesk Forma Industry Cloud, collaborating with software architects, domain experts, and product teams across Revit, Civil 3D, AutoCAD, Autodesk Construction Cloud, and Autodesk Forma. This is a senior individual-contributor role on an established architecture track, reporting to the Distinguished Architect of the AEC Data team, who also serves as the Lead Software Architect. The primary responsibility is to shape how multiple teams design and build - through standards, reference architectures, ADRs, and design-review governance - rather than to own a single service. The exact focus flexes to the candidate's strengths and organizational need. Responsibilities API Design & Evolution : Design and evolve API surfaces across the AEC Data services - resource modeling, addressing, versioning and backward-compatible evolution, query APIs, and unifying overlapping surfaces into a single coherent contract System Architecture : Define and evolve cross-team, cloud-native architecture across the AEC Data services; design distributed systems including service contracts and event-driven flows Schema Design & Evolution : Design, document, and evolve data schemas for AEC domain entities (buildings, infrastructure, spaces, systems, components, relationships) - including semantic models, property sets, classification systems, and relationship hierarchies. Own versioning, backward/forward compatibility, deprecation, and migration; maintain the schema registry, validation rules, and quality checks Standards & Governance : Establish standards, reference architectures, and reusable components; author architecture proposals and decision records (ADRs) for review by a cross-org architecture council, and run cross-team design reviews Prototyping & Feasibility : Evaluate alternative architectural directions through modeling and prototyping, de-risking key decisions before broad adoption Mentorship & Technical Leadership : Mentor developers and fellow architects on emerging and established technologies and on architectural practice; grow technical depth across teams Reliability & Performance : Ensure reliability, security, and performance of systems; define SLOs and drive observability (metrics, tracing, logging) Communication : Communicate architecture with clear views and diagrams (e.g., C4) and executive-ready narratives; produce comprehensive documentation and onboarding materials Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or equivalent experience 10+ years designing cloud-native, distributed systems, including 5+ years at cross-team architect altitude (Software Architect, Principal Developer, Staff+, or equivalent). Title is flexible; scope of impact is the primary consideration Deep expertise in cloud services (ideally AWS), API/service design, and distributed-systems patterns (microservices, event-driven, resilience) Solid grounding in data modeling and schema design - including schema definition languages (e.g., JSON Schema), versioning, and backward/forward-compatibility and evolution strategies - as applied both to standalone data schemas and to API contracts. Specialist data-warehouse or analytics architecture is not required Excellent knowledge of software design and architecture patterns Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and drive alignment across teams outside the candidate's direct management Strong leadership and mentoring skills, with a track record of guiding and growing diverse, cross-functional teams Mastery of conveying complex ideas concisely and persuasively, with excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills across a range of stakeholders Ability to collaborate with a global team Preferred Qualifications Preferred qualifications are a menu rather than a checklist: depth in a few core areas matters more than breadth across all of them. The emerging AI/ML capabilities below are advantageous and can be developed on the job; they are not prerequisites. Core Cloud Services : AWS and its core services (EC2, ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, RDS) Distributed Systems : Domain-driven service decomposition, data consistency patterns (CQRS, event sourcing, sagas), and multi-tenant/multi-region design API & Service Design : REST API design and evolution; GraphQL (including federation) Database Architecture : Relational and NoSQL (e.g., DynamoDB, PostgreSQL) Observability/SRE : OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, metrics/SLOs for data services Bonus Semantic Technologies : Knowledge graphs, RDF/OWL, or property graphs - particularly relevant to the connected/semantic AECDM BIM Expertise : Building Information Modeling concepts, Revit families, or similar parametric modeling systems AI Systems : RAG, agents/MCP, agentic orchestration (LangGraph, Semantic Kernel), LLM observability, and data governance / AI safety (PII, prompt-injection, content filtering) Domain-Specific AI for AEC : BIM/IFC extraction, CAD or point-cloud processing Event-Driven Architectures : Kafka or Kinesis; schema registries (Confluent, AWS Glue); exactly-once processing AEC Domain Knowledge : Experience in the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction industry; familiarity with industry standards (IFC, COBie, gbXML, CityGML, LandXML, UniFormat, OmniClass). items.description: Management and Finance Headquarters: San Francisco Bay Area or New York (Remote) Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games. Ad Operations and Sales Analytics support Discord's ads business, partnering with Sales, Product, Engineering, Data Science, and other cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality campaign executions, impactful data insights, and go-to-market strategy across our advertising products. As an Ad Operations Manager, you will play a crucial part in scaling our Ads business. You'll improve the efficiency and scale of campaign execution while contributing to deep-dive analyses that drive business growth and inform go-to-market strategy. You'll provide valuable feedback to Product and Engineering teams, directly impacting Discord's advertising capabilities while removing friction from customers' experience with our platform. What You'll Be Doing Ensuring ad campaigns are implemented and launched on time and to specification — including campaign parameters such as dates, targeting, tracking, impression/reach goals, geographies, and budget — working closely with Account Executives and Account Managers to align setups with client objectives Providing hands-on technical support to key customers and Ad Sales partners, and owning the processes and escalation path (in partnership with Engineering) for issues related to platform integration and use Partnering with Account Managers and technical teams to optimize campaign outcomes and maximize client ROI, including troubleshooting and A/B testing of messaging, creative, and targeting Synthesizing campaign performance insights for internal stakeholders and clients — performance, trends, ROI, and actionable recommendations Building and scaling automations and tooling (including AI/LLM-based workflows) that reduce manual effort and increase leverage across the team Serving as the operational engine for multiple revenue-driving functions across the Discord Business Organization What you should have 3–5+ years of experience in digital advertising, ad operations, or related roles Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g., LLM-based workflows, scripting/automation) to drive measurable efficiency gains in a professional environment Comfort working with data and light scripting — SQL required; Python or similar strongly preferred — to build or maintain internal tooling and reporting pipelines Demonstrated knowledge of a broad variety of ad technologies, campaign operation methodologies, and ad tracking/measurement solutions Experience partnering with Engineering and/or Product on technical escalations, platform integrations, or API-level troubleshooting Successful track record working directly with clients — understanding needs and delivering value Strong analytical proficiency: ability to query and interpret data, generate insights, and make data-driven decisions Familiarity with market trends and KPIs such as viewability, brand safety, yield analysis, and audience extension Excellent communication and collaboration skills in a fast-changing, cross-functional environment Bonus Points Experience designing or building internal automation/tooling (bots, pipelines, dashboards) that scaled a team's operations Team player with a sense of humor, humility, curiosity, and empathy This position is US-based and can be based in New York (remote) or San Francisco but if you live in the Bay Area, you’re welcome to work from our beautiful SF office. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits. Why Discord? Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission!
