items.description: Flex is building the AI-native private bank for business owners . We’re re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs—from the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, and financial operations—rebuilt from the ground up as a single, intelligent system. Flex is the full financial home for ambitious owners. Since launching publicly in September 2023 , Flex has scaled from zero to nine-figure annualized revenue , with a clear path to profitability by late 2026 . We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership. Our customers are affluent business owners ($3–$200M in revenue) —the backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. They’re stuck with outdated banks and fragmented tools. We’re replacing all of it. The opportunity is massive: a ~$1T+ revenue market hiding in plain sight. Our ambition is to build a $100B+ company by delivering a product that is fundamentally better—not incrementally improved. Flex has raised $100M+ in equity and $300M+ in debt. - Mission-critical problems : We build software that directly controls how money moves at scale. - High bar, low ego : Small teams, exceptional people, real ownership. - Speed over comfort : We prioritize execution, quality, clarity, and results. - Enduring impact : What we’re building will define how a generation of owners runs their businesses. Team & Locations We hire exceptional people who want to build hard things and see their work matter immediately. Roles are available in: San Francisco, Miami, New York, and fully remote. Flex Fuels Ambition. About the role We're looking for a frontline BDR Manager to lead a team of 7–9 IC BDRs and report directly to our Head of Sales Development. You'll be the day-to-day coach, performance manager, and operator for the team — owning ramp, pipeline pacing, and the AE+BDR pod motion that drives our top of funnel. This is a player-coach role for someone who loves building teams, not managing dashboards. You'll have real input on hiring, comp, tooling, and how we run outbound — and a direct hand in scaling the BDR org through its next phase of growth. What you'll do Manage and coach 7–9 BDRs through weekly 1:1s, call reviews, and pipeline reviews Own ramp and performance management for new hires and existing reps Drive the AE+BDR pod motion — joint account work, weekly sprints, creative outbound Partner with the Head of Sales Development on team strategy, hiring, and quota planning Work cross-functionally with AEs, Marketing, RevOps, and Enablement to keep the team set up to win Hire and onboard the next layer of the BDR team alongside Recruiting What we're looking for Prior experience as a BDR or SDR yourself before moving into leadership — you've sat in the seat and made the calls Prior experience leading a BDR or SDR team as a manager, team lead, or player-coach A track record of coaching reps to quota and managing pipeline metrics (SQLs, conversion, ramp) Fintech background strongly preferred — financial infrastructure, payments, spend management, or B2B fintech experience is a major plus Comfort operating in a fast-moving startup environment where decisions get made quickly and priorities shift A naturally cross-functional operating style — you build relationships across AEs, Marketing, and Ops without friction Strong communication and a coaching-first mindset, with the ability to hold a high bar on accountability We don't have a hard years-of-experience requirement. If you've done the work, that's what matters. Nice to have Experience with our tech stack: Salesforce, Apollo, Orum, Claude Experience hiring and ramping BDRs at a Series A–C startup Compensation Additional Information Why join Flex You'll lead one of the most important teams in the company at the moment it matters most. The BDR org is set to roughly double over the next 12–18 months, and you'll have the chance to shape how it operates long-term — the ramp, the pod structure, the hiring bar, the culture. Direct line to senior leadership, real equity, and the kind of problems that make the next role on your resume an easy one to land. Compensation: $90,000–$125,000 OTE plus equity Location: Remote, US-based, with occasional travel for off-sites Employment type: Full-time

items.description: ABOUT OUTRIGHT INTERNATIONAL Founded in 1990, Outright International strives to help lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, intersex, and queer (LGBTIQ) people live safer, healthier, and more empowered lives worldwide. With staff in 18 countries and global headquarters in New York City, Outright documents human rights violations, helps resource LGBTIQ movements and allies, and advocates for the rights of LGBTIQ people. Reporting to the Senior Director of Global Programs and Grantmaking, the Program Manager will manage the program's implementation across its target regions, serving as the primary link between Outright's leadership, regional program staff, and in-country partners to ensure the program is delivered in a locally owned, demand-driven, and donor-compliant manner. Key Responsibilities Program Oversight and Implementation Lead day-to-day management of a large, multi-country grant portfolio, ensuring activities align with donor requirements and organizational strategy Coordinate across regional program staff to ensure coherent implementation in high-risk, conflict-affected, and restrictive operating environments Oversee program inception phase, including finalization of Theory of Change, MEL plan, and capacity strengthening plans with in-country partners Partner Management Manage relationships with a diverse portfolio of in-country partner organizations, including selection, risk assessment, and reassessment processes Oversee co-design and rollout of individualized capacity strengthening plans with partners, ensuring demand-driven and participatory approaches Support flexible, partner-led financing mechanisms including emergency, programmatic, and organizational development funding Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning Coordinate participatory MEL processes with partners, including outcome mapping, baselines, and qualitative assessment tools in close cooperation with Outright´s MEL team Track programmatic and contextual risk registers, escalating significant shifts and coordinating adaptive management responses Liaise with external MEL consultants and support donor-led baseline and mid-term evaluation processes Risk and Safeguarding Monitor evolving political, security, and civic-space risks across the program's regions and adjust implementation accordingly Ensure safeguarding standards (including SEAH prevention) are upheld across all partner relationships Coordinate risk-sharing arrangements and contingency planning with partners and internal compliance teams Advocacy Coordination Support in-country partners' engagement with regional and multilateral human rights mechanisms Coordinate logistics and strategic input for partner participation in international convenings and advocacy weeks Ensure advocacy priorities remain demand-driven and reflect partner-identified needs Compliance and Reporting Ensure adherence to donor financial and narrative reporting requirements across all in-country partners Coordinate with finance and grants teams on disbursement schedules, compliance checks, and sanctions screening Prepare consolidated narrative and financial reports for donor submission Qualifications items.title: Clinician (Oncology / Hematology)
items.summary: Role Title: Clinician (Oncology / Hematology) Role Type: ContractorLocation: Remotemicro1 is engaging Clinician (Oncology / Hematology)s to contribute to a customer’s project at the forefront of AI in healthcare.
items.description: Role Title: Clinician (Oncology / Hematology) Role Type: Contractor Location: Remote micro1 is engaging Clinician (Oncology / Hematology)s to contribute to a customer’s project at the forefront of AI in healthcare. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. Scope of Work Author and review evaluation tasks that require nuanced clinical judgment, leveraging Clinical Study Reports, periodic safety reports, and regulatory correspondence in oncology and haematology. Assess the clinical defensibility of efficacy and safety conclusions, ensuring endpoints and effect sizes reflect true clinical significance. Apply advanced judgment to dose escalation, dose-limiting toxicity, modifications, adverse event grading and attribution, and the coherence of patient narratives. Evaluate benefit-risk reasoning, scrutinizing the durability of conclusions in light of new events, and the realism of described management strategies. Identify and flag content that is clinically implausible or internally inconsistent, distinguishing these from legitimate clinical variation. Provide structured, guideline-based written rationales that clearly explain the validity or limitations of clinical interpretations for a non-clinical audience. Preferred Qualifications Specialist registration or board certification in medical oncology and/or haematology, with 5+ years of post-training clinical experience. Direct involvement in clinical trials as investigator, sub-investigator, or sponsor-side medical monitor, safety physician, or clinical development physician. Proficiency with CTCAE grading, relevant response criteria (RECIST, Lugano, IMWG, IWCLL, ELN), and outcome endpoints (ORR, DoR, PFS, OS, MRD). Hands-on experience with trial documents such as protocols, investigator brochures, CSRs, safety narratives, or DSMB/IDMC materials. Demonstrated excellence in written communication, with clear, structured explanations of clinical reasoning tailored for non-clinical readers. Previous roles in medical monitoring or as medical director on oncology or haematology programmes, and committee participation (IDMC, DSMB, adjudication, or independent review committees). Peer-reviewed publication record or authorship on clinical trial manuscripts, with any exposure to AI-assisted clinical review tools seen as a plus. Originally posted on Himalayas

In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. Scope of Work Review complex adolescent cases to assess sexual safety and exploitation (CSE/CSA) risks. Active clinical license or registration in good standing. Current or recent (within the last two years) adolescent caseload or safeguarding practice. Demonstrated expertise in CSE/CSA risk assessment and mandatory-reporting requirements. Strong skills in trauma-informed practice and documentation. Exceptional written communication in research-grade English (native, or IELTS 7.5+/writing 7.0+, TOEFL 100+, Cambridge C1–C2, or equivalent). Experience in a designated safeguarding or expert-witness capacity, and familiarity with ACEs and trauma frameworks, is a plus. Start Timeline & Availability We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts ready to jump in right away. If selected, we expect you to start your first tasks within 24 – 48 hours of completing onboarding. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: External Communications Strategist
items.summary: Are you a dreamer, innovator, thinker and a do-er who believes in contributing to something that makes difference?
items.description: Are you a dreamer, innovator, thinker and a do-er who believes in contributing to something that makes difference? Make an impact. Join PMI. How will you make a difference to PMI? The External Communications Strategist III is an execution-first, senior individual contributor responsible for driving earned media opportunities and narrative enablement in support of PMI’s corporate reputation, thought leadership, and strategic priorities. This role sits within the PR + Communications team and operates with a high degree of autonomy, judgment, and ownership. As a Level III individual contributor, this role is expected to operate as a trusted advisor within Communications—anticipating opportunities, identifying risks, and independently driving work forward while ensuring alignment to broader narrative and reputational priorities. You will provide strategic counsel to senior stakeholders on external narrative direction, message discipline, and reputational considerations, and recommend narrative adjustments based on trends, current events, and performance insights. What you’ll bring to the role: Earned Media Strategy & Agency Partnership Collaborate with PR agency to identify story opportunities and develop timely, compelling pitch angles aligned to priority narrative beats for both B2B and consumer audiences. Maximize PR agency performance helping to sharpen briefs, challenge thinking, and ensure proactive, high-quality execution against PMI’s strategic communications goals. Partner with PR agency (and consult with internal stakeholders, including regional and functional leads) on developing strategy and positioning for global media house moments. Partner with the broader Marketing organization to source appropriate community or executive spokespeople; vet, prepare, and align them for earned media pitching and engagements. Use media intelligence and performance insights (e.g., message pull-through, tier-1 quality, topic traction) to identify narrative opportunities and gaps, and to refine story angles and pitching strategy. Shape earned media strategies that strengthen PMI’s discoverability and influence in search and AI-driven answer environments, ensuring coverage reinforces desired brand perception, priority narratives, and authoritative topic associations. Earned & Sponsored External Opportunities Independently or collaboratively identify and execute strategic earned opportunities for PMI executives or community spokespeople to reach unaware or new audiences (e.g., third-party events, podcasts, partner activations, key account–adjacent moments). Partner with PR agency and relevant internal teams to evaluate, secure, and execute selective sponsored opportunities (e.g., panels, conferences, tentpole events) that advance PMI’s narratives and reputational goals. Assess external opportunities for narrative fit, audience value, and reputational considerations; recommend go/no-go decisions and execute approved engagements end-to-end. Identify and shape thought leadership platforms (e.g., executive bylines, strategic reports, high-impact forums, and selective partnerships) that reinforce priority narratives and differentiate PMI’s point of view. Narrative Ownership & Enablement Lead efforts for defined corporate message houses, including maintenance of current proof points, examples, and data, ensuring they reflect evolving business priorities and external context. Own external narrative governance for assigned topics (message architecture, claims/proof points, and executive-ready guidance), ensuring consistency across earned media, executive platforms, and thought leadership moments. Define what is included in narrative-specific enablement kits (e.g., message houses, executive-ready slides, talk tracks, FAQs, supporting materials) and proactively distribute to internal stakeholders and executives ahead of external opportunities. Maintain and refresh enablement kits on a regular cadence; communicate updates clearly and ensure adoption across PR, Marketing, and regional teams. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Judgment Work closely with Director of PR & Communications, Marketing, regional teams, and agency partners to ensure narrative consistency and executional excellence across external touchpoints. Influence senior stakeholders and cross-functional partners to align on narrative, timing, and external positioning—often without direct authority—and deliver clear recommendations (including go/no-go) in ambiguous, high-visibility situations. Maintain issues readiness for assigned narratives, including rapid response positioning, Q&A, and escalation recommendations in reputationally sensitive moments. Navigate nuanced, high-visibility topics with maturity and discretion; identify risks early (misalignment, gaps, timing, tone) and recommend solutions. Independently manage multiple workstreams and deadlines; maintain clear tracking of opportunities, deliverables, approvals, and outcomes. Role Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Marketing, Public Relations, or related field (or equivalent experience). 8-10+ years of experience in corporate communications, PR, or earned media–focused roles. Demonstrated experience partnering with and managing PR agencies to drive earned media outcomes. Proven track record of developing and executing proactive earned media or external engagement strategies tied to corporate narratives. Experience operating with senior-level autonomy and judgment in complex, matrixed organizations. Strong earned media instincts with the ability to translate narrative strategy into executable story angles. Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to distill complex topics into clear, compelling messages. High judgment and discretion; comfortable operating in reputationally sensitive areas. Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills. Highly organized, self-directed operator with strong prioritization and follow-through. Ability to anticipate needs, proactively identify opportunities, and execute with minimal oversight. Stakeholder management is paramount; ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment on narrative direction and recommendations. Strategic, analytical mindset with the ability to use insights and reporting to optimize external communications strategy and outcomes. Proficiency in the business language for PMI (English). Possible travel up to 5% What you can expect from us We value and nurture an environment of inclusivity and diversity, and a culture of communication and collaboration. Your health, safety and well-being come first, and we believe that you should have time for your work, but you should also have time for you.. Join us and you’ll get: an excellent total package, with compensation and benefits based upon your geographic location. skill development opportunities, to help you grow now and into the future. access to a global network, to enrich your professional experience. flexible options to help balance work time and your time award and bonus opportunities. The salary offer will be based on several factors, including the candidate’s demonstrated skills, qualifications and relevant experience. Let’s help make the world work better for everyone. Apply today! Project Management Institute, Inc. is committed to providing equal employment opportunities without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religious creed, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. items.description: About Us Mighty Networks helps people and brands build communities, online courses, memberships, challenges, and events. Because of this novel approach and member-centered experience, Mighty has produced the most $1M communities and helped its Hosts earn over $500M. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in both structured systems and creative problem-solving, and is excited to model excellence, mentor peers, and scale success through repeatable frameworks. What You'll Do Serve as a strategic partner to new Mighty Pro Hosts during their onboarding phase as they set up their Network in the way that leads to maximum member adoption, engagement, and retention. Facilitate impactful workshops with Hosts and their teams that establish strong foundations in community design, content cadence, and engagement strategy. Deliver targeted training on feature utilization, member onboarding flows, and tactical programming to drive adoption, activation, and retention. Provide creative input and feedback on brand elements like landing pages, welcome experiences, email sequences, and network messaging to ensure a cohesive and compelling member journey. Own the development and delivery of strategic Community Design Plans—including network architecture, monthly themes, onboarding flows, and launch programming calendars. Collaborate closely with Launch Specialists and Implementation teams, providing timely information and handling lightweight setup tasks directly where appropriate. Ensure clarity, consistency, and excellence in the execution of space configuration, access structure, and end-to-end member experience. Maintain regular updates to internal stakeholders on Host performance, needs, risks, and outcomes—contributing to visibility and cross-functional alignment. Contribute to shared knowledge across the Customer Success team by capturing and scaling best practices, identifying emerging trends, and improving playbooks. What We're Looking For 6+ years of client-facing experience, ideally working with strategic accounts or supporting 5–6 figure engagements in a SaaS, media, or creator-focused business. 2+ years experience in a consulting, business coaching, or agency role. Strategic thinker and tactical executor—you can map out long-term plans, define metrics for success, and follow through on details to deliver. Deep understanding of community-building and digital member experiences; you’re passionate about helping others create belonging at scale. Excellent communicator and facilitator, with confidence in guiding executive teams through planning, decision-making, and feedback cycles. Master of meetings—you show up with a plan, gather input with nuance, read the room, and close with clear decisions and next steps. Adaptable and proactive, energized by growth and ambiguity, and always seeking ways to streamline and improve. Highly collaborative and cross-functional, thriving when working across CS, Implementation, Product, and Strategy to elevate outcomes. Radically curious, with a growth mindset and drive to keep learning about Hosts, their businesses, and how digital communities are evolving. What We Offer A dynamic, remote-first work culture that values creativity, autonomy, and bold thinking. Comprehensive benefits, including health, vision, dental, and generous paid time off. Clear opportunities for professional growth, including leadership pathways and skill development support. The chance to shape the future of how communities, creators, and brands thrive online—with the team that’s building what’s next. Join us in shaping the future of community-driven digital businesses with Mighty Pro! Compensation: The base salary for this role ranges from $80,000–$145,000, with exact compensation based on location, experience, and cost of living. Originally posted on Himalayas

At LooseGrip, we're a boutique digital consultancy that transforms brands through data-inspired storytelling and performance marketing. We're looking for a Junior Designer to support our digital marketing campaigns-someone with a strong eye, a curious mind, and the hustle to turn briefs into beautifully executed visuals. This is a part-time contract role with flexible hours and real opportunities to grow alongside a tight-knit team. What You'll Do Design for the scroll. Create on-brand social graphics, paid ad creative, email assets, and landing page visuals for a range of digital marketing campaigns. Bring briefs to life. Translate creative direction and campaign goals into clean, compelling design that drives engagement and performance. Stay on brand. Work within established brand systems, applying guidelines consistently across formats, channels, and clients. Iterate fast. items.summary: Seer Interactive is a digital marketing consultancy that harnesses compassion, data, technology, and AI to make a mark on our communities, our coworkers, our clients, our industry, and our neighbors. We relentlessly pursue (and share) the truth, bringing together millions of data points from quantitative and qualitative sources, enhanced by respons
items.description: Seer Interactive is a digital marketing consultancy that harnesses compassion, data, technology, and AI to make a mark on our communities, our coworkers, our clients, our industry, and our neighbors. We relentlessly pursue (and share) the truth, bringing together millions of data points from quantitative and qualitative sources, enhanced by responsible, human-centered AI. Our purpose is to unlock potential across these communities, envisioning a world where doing the right thing is intuitive and informed. At Seer, we see AI as a catalyst for innovation, collaboration, and creativity. Regardless of your division or discipline, leveraging AI is a core part of how we deliver smarter, faster, and more strategic outcomes for our clients. Our AI Council drives company-wide integration by focusing on education, purposeful implementation, and continuous learning, ensuring that AI is embedded in how we think, operate, and grow. If you’re ready to uplift others, challenge your ego, commit to the truth, and be better than yesterday—keep reading. Seer is a remote-first agency and a Certified B-Corp, with team members across the country. If an office environment is more your style, this position can also sit in our HQ office in Philadelphia. We can only consider candidates based in the US who can work continental US-based hours. The Role: If the idea of dialing for dollars makes you want to close the tab, keep reading. This role isn’t that. You’re a digital marketing practitioner who has spent years building strategies, presenting to executives, and making the case for how channels work together to drive business outcomes. You’ve been selling your expertise all along but you just never called it sales. At Seer, you’ll take that instinct and apply it to one of the most intellectually honest growth practices in the industry: building (inbound) relationships with major brands, figuring out which ones we can actually help, and building the strategy to prove it. Role Highlights Lead Qualification & Consultative Discovery We have a pipeline of 600+ inbound leads annually, your job is to ask the right questions, get to the truth quickly, and be just as willing to disqualify a lead as you are to close it Run discovery calls with Fortune 500 marketing teams to understand their business challenges, channel mix, digital maturity, and what success actually looks like for them Strategy & Pitch Development Collaborate with divisional experts across SEO, Paid Media, Analytics, and Creative to build data-informed, channel-integrated growth strategies tailored to each prospect Lead pitch presentations and proposals for prospects up to the C-suite that show exactly how Seer can move the needle Negotiate and finalize contracts with legal guidance when deals are ready to close Pipeline & Client Handoff Manage the full process from first contact through client kick-off, ensuring every new partner is a strong values and capability fit before anything is signed Deliver a seamless handoff to account teams so every new client relationship starts on solid ground Thought Leadership & Community Contribute to the Seer blog, speak at industry events, and engage in professional communities to build Seer’s brand and surface new business conversations organically Essential Skills You have a depth of knowledge in digital marketing. You understand how SEO, paid media, analytics, and other channels interact to drive business outcomes, not just how one channel works in isolation You are a natural relationship builder who has spent your career earning trust with clients or stakeholders, not a stranger to a high-stakes conversation You have experience presenting strategy to senior decision-makers and can translate complexity into clarity for a VP or CMO audience You are comfortable operating autonomously with a high-volume workload and bring structure and discipline to your own pipeline You are data-driven, you use numbers to qualify, build your case, and sharpen your approach over time You feel energized by the consultative side of client work, you want to solve real problems, not pitch from a script You are comfortable with ambiguity and can make good decisions with incomplete information You have experience working with AI tools to accelerate research, analysis, or strategy development and you’re always looking for ways to work smarter Bonus! You have a background in Client Engagement, Account Management, or a client-facing strategy role and have been responsible for organic account growth You have experience in a digital agency environment where you’ve pitched or contributed to pitches for new clients You have familiarity with tools like Pipedrive, HubSpot, or LinkedIn Sales Navigator You have hands-on channel experience in more than one discipline (e.g., SEO + Paid, or Paid + Analytics) This might not be the right role for you if You thrive on cold outreach and commission-based incentives, this role is 90% inbound with a full salary and bonus, not a commission structure You specialize deeply in one digital marketing channel but haven’t had to make the case for how channels work together You prefer to stay in execution mode and aren’t energized by client-facing conversations or the business side of the work You need a highly defined playbook to follow: this role requires judgment, curiosity, and comfort with figuring things out in real time Saying “no” to a potential client feels like failure, here, disqualifying the wrong-fit lead is part of doing the job well 30/60/90 First 30 Days — Learn Immerse yourself in Seer’s pitch process, service offerings, and the types of leads we work best with Shadow discovery calls and strategy presentations to understand how the Business Strategy team qualifies and wins business Begin running your own discovery conversations with inbound leads under guidance 60 Days — Build Independently own the full discovery process on a set of inbound leads from first call through proposal Build your first pitch collaboratively with a divisional SME and present it to a real prospect Develop your working understanding of when to push forward and when a lead isn’t the right fit 90 Days — Lead Owning your pipeline end-to-end with a clear handle on close rate, average deal size, and time-to-close Contributing intelligence back to the team on patterns you’re seeing what kinds of leads convert, what objections come up, what the market is saying Tracking toward a $2M annual revenue target from inbound leads $120,000 - $150,000 a year OTE for this role is $120,000-150,000/year This OTE is base + bonus based on revenue attainment Your final offered compensation will be determined by your skills and experience Evaluation of comp at least once a year Benefit highlights Ready to apply? Ditch the cover letter — we don’t need it. We’d rather see your AI chops. Use our Marketing Career AI Self-Assessment GPT to find out where you land on the AI marketing maturity curve and share your results with us. Our team is excited to read your application responses and will be using them to help determine who we’d like to meet with! Have questions about recruitment at Seer? Check out our Custom GPT: Guide to Talent Acquisition at Seer to drop in your questions! You can ask it anything about our hiring process, and how to best prepare for an interview with us. As a B-Corp Certified organization, we are committed to creating an inclusive environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Not ready to apply but want to keep in touch? Stay connected via our monthly Career Update newsletter! We’ll share curated content on Seer, open roles, industry insights, career advice, events you don’t want to miss, and more (so you never miss a beat). #LI-Remote We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

items.description: Who is Boulevard? Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most. Before launching in 2016, our founders spent months interviewing salon managers and working behind front desks to understand their pain points so we could design a modern, user-friendly platform that meets the unique needs of their business. Our roots may be in hair salons, but we are built for the broader self-care industry, including many types of salons, spas, medspa, barbershops, and more. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen . We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most . Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too. Come do the best work of your life at Boulevard. We're hiring a Director of Engineering - Cloud & Reliability to lead our infrastructure transformation and establish industry leading reliability practices. This role will be instrumental in evolving Boulevard's infrastructure into a scalable, reliable, secure, and highly available platform that supports our rapid growth and customer needs across a spectrum of market segments (Small Business, Franchises, Enterprises). Reporting to the SVP of Engineering, you'll lead a team of infrastructure and reliability engineers while driving the technical strategy for our cloud infrastructure, DevOps practices, and platform capabilities. Your work will directly enable the Engineering & Data teams to deliver APIs, services, customer-facing products and data capabilities at scale by providing robust, self-service infrastructure foundations. You'll architect and implement modern infrastructure practices including containerization, infrastructure-as-code, advanced CI/CD pipelines, and comprehensive observability systems. This role is perfect for a technical leader who wants to build the infrastructure platform that becomes the backbone of Boulevard's next phase of growth. Domains of Ownership Cloud Infrastructure & Platform - Design, implement, and maintain scalable AWS infrastructure including multi-region deployments, and infrastructure-as-code DevOps & CI/CD - Transform deployment pipelines, implement container orchestration, and enable rapid, reliable software delivery Observability & Reliability - Implement comprehensive monitoring, alerting, and incident response using DataDog and related tools Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity - Establish DR infrastructure, failover systems, and business continuity planning across all Boulevard services Infrastructure Automation - Build self-service infrastructure capabilities and advanced automation using Terraform and GitOps practices Security & Compliance - Establish comprehensive security practices, manage compliance frameworks (PCI, HIPAA, SOC 2), and implement security-by-design principles Key Projects & Initiatives EKS Migration & Containerization : Lead the migration from current infrastructure to Amazon EKS, implementing container orchestration and services-ready architecture Multi-Region DR Implementation : Design and implement hot-hot disaster recovery with automated failover, load balancing, and regular testing procedures CI/CD Pipeline Transformation : Modernize deployment pipelines to support faster, more reliable deployments Advanced Observability : Enhance comprehensive monitoring, alerting, and incident response using DataDog, enabling proactive issue detection and resolution Security Framework : Establish enterprise-grade security practices, compliance frameworks, and automation to support Data team's governance requirements Infrastructure-as-Code Evolution : Scale Terraform usage, implement GitOps practices, and create self-service infrastructure capabilities Database Scaling : Address current RDS limitations and implement scalable database architecture What you'll do here: Technical Leadership : Define and execute the long-term infrastructure and security strategy, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security as Boulevard grows Team Building : Lead, mentor, and grow a team of infrastructure and reliability engineers, establishing best practices and fostering a culture of operational excellence Cross-functional Collaboration : Partner closely with Product, Services and Data Engineering teams to provide the infrastructure foundation for their initiatives Architecture & Design : Drive architectural decisions for cloud infrastructure, security systems, and operational practices Operational Excellence : Establish monitoring, alerting, and incident response practices that ensure high availability and performance Compliance Management : Ensure compliance with industry standards (PCI, HIPAA, SOC 2) and implement security controls What you'll need to thrive: 10+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure and platform engineering, with 5+ years leading infrastructure teams of 5-15 engineers Deep experience with AWS services including EKS, RDS, VPC, IAM, and infrastructure automation using Terraform Proven experience migrating applications to Kubernetes/EKS and implementing container-based architectures Strong background in security practices, compliance frameworks (PCI, HIPAA, SOC 2), and security automation Experience transforming CI/CD pipelines, implementing GitOps practices, and enabling rapid software delivery Expertise with monitoring and observability tools (DataDog, Prometheus, Grafana) and implementing comprehensive alerting strategies Proven ability to work with Product Engineering, Data Engineering, and Platform Services teams to enable their technical initiatives How we'll take care of you: At Boulevard, we work hard to structure compensation in a way that balances internal equity with local market competitiveness, and we’re happy to share a good-faith estimate of the base salary range for this role. For U.S. based candidates, the anticipated base salary range is $209,500 - $270,000 per year. In addition to this base compensation, this role may be eligible to participate in a variable compensation program. Final compensation will vary based on a variety of factors which include but are not limited to applicable experience, location, and final leveling. In addition to the wonderful people you’ll get to work with and challenging projects that’ll push you - Boulevard is here to make sure you’re always at the top of your game emotionally, mentally, and physically. ✨ We’ve got you covered with a 401(k) match plus dental, medical, vision, and life insurance. Take a break whenever you need with our flexible vacation day policy. Fully remote so you can choose where you want to work. You’ll receive a work from home stipend every month. Family planning resources and specialized support programs. Equity: get ahead on the ground floor and grow with Boulevard. Boulevard Bucks Learning and Development program allows employees to explore businesses in the market we serve. We recommend following our official LinkedIn page to stay up to date on all things Boulevard life! Boulevard Labs, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to hiring a diverse workforce and sustaining an inclusive culture. All employment decisions at Boulevard Labs, Inc. are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

items.description: Apaleo is the world’s most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure enables hoteliers to customise their tech stack, automate routine work, and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay. About the role Revenue Operations keeps Apaleo's GTM engine running, and running toward one thing: revenue growth. As our RevOps Engineer, you'll work across the go-to-market org making sure the systems and data behind the funnel are clean, fast, and increasingly AI-native. You'll work directly with our Team Lead RevOps, and while you'll touch nearly every GTM function, growth and pipeline are where your work has the clearest line to revenue. What you'll do Own and maintain our CRM (HubSpot), keeping data clean, pipelines accurate, and workflows humming — the foundation everything AI touches depends on Query our data with AI to answer real business questions (why a metric moved, which accounts look like our best customers) instead of waiting on a dashboard to tell you Build AI agents and automations for repetitive RevOps work — CRM hygiene, lead routing, reporting — using n8n, Claude, and our existing stack When a number moves and the dashboard can't say why, dig into calls, emails, and tickets, using AI to get to the real cause faster Manage our toolstack day to day, including HubSpot, n8n, lemlist, modjo, sales navigator, etc. Document how each automation you build works — inputs, what it touches, when it should hand off to a human — so someone else could pick it up without you in the room Flag issues before they become problems and propose simple, practical fixes proactively, using AI to get there faster Work closely with sales, marketing, customer success, partner management, onboarding, support, BI, finance, and product on cross-functional requests What you bring Proven experience in a RevOps, sales ops, or marketing ops role Solid HubSpot skills, comfortable with workflows, properties, and reporting on funnel and pipeline metrics Genuinely AI-fluent: you use AI tools daily and have built at least one real automation or agent — not just used a chatbot Comfortable digging into messy, unstructured data (calls, emails, tickets) to find an answer a dashboard won't give you Documents your work well enough that someone else could run it without you in the room A structured mindset and a bias for action Strong attention to detail without losing sight of the bigger picture Genuine interest in how pipeline gets built and converted, not just how data gets cleaned Good communication skills, you'll work closely with GTM leadership Experience with an AI-native growth stack - think Clay for enrichment/agents, n8n or Make for workflow automation, Claude or ChatGPT for building agents, and intent tools like Koala or Clearbit - is a big plus What We Offer Culture & Growth A Diverse & International Team: Work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities, bringing unique cultural perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences to shape the future of hospitality tech. Growth & Development: As we scale, so do your opportunities. You’ll benefit from 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget, and plenty of chances to take on more responsibility. Our evolving career framework ensures you have increasing opportunities to learn new skills, advance your career, and make an impact. Autonomy & Ownership: Great ideas can come from anywhere. We empower you to take responsibility, make decisions, and contribute directly in an environment built on trust, transparency, and collaboration. Shape the Future of Hospitality Tech: Be part of a fast-growing scale-up transforming the hospitality industry. From day one, your work drives real impact and you’ll have the freedom to bring your ideas to life. Competitive & Fair Compensation: We believe great work deserves great pay. Our salaries are competitive and guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. We make sure to recognize and reward performance and contribution. Perks & Lifestyle Flexible & Remote Work Options: We focus on results, not clocking hours. You can work from home, the office or in a hybrid setup, with flexibility to adapt your schedule as long as it makes sense for your role, your team and our business. Free Public Transport: Travel across Germany with ease using our fully covered Deutschland Ticket . Team Connection: Strong connections fuel collaboration. We celebrate and connect through regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties, and other offsite events. Paid Time Off: Enjoy 30 days of vacation to fully disconnect, recharge, and return inspired. Health & Wellbeing: Prioritize your health with access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios, and wellness options through our EGYM Wellpass membership. How you make an impact joining Apaleo: Joining Apaleo means more than just taking on a role it’s about driving real change in the hospitality industry. Your contributions will directly shape our innovative platform, influence company-wide decisions, and help redefine the future of hospitality tech. At Apaleo, your voice matters, your ideas are valued, and your impact is tangible. Be part of a team where your work fuels progress, collaboration sparks innovation, and growth is a shared journey. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and welcoming workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data will be handled with the utmost care and in compliance with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations. We celebrate differences and believe that diversity enriches our team and drives innovation.

items.description: Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send thousands of payouts to anyone, anywhere, for free. We're trusted by 20,000 organizations like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way to deliver gift cards and money to millions of recipients worldwide. Our customers (researchers, marketers, HR teams, nonprofits, and platform businesses) rave about how fast and easy Tremendous is to use. Check out our ratings on G2 . Tremendous is profitable and growing without outside investors. We’re a fully remote, high-documentation, low-meeting culture, which means more time for what matters in both your professional and personal life. The team agrees– our employee NPS is in the high 80s. Design at Tremendous We design experiences that make complex systems feel straightforward and intuitive by taking our time to get things right. We favor depth and scale over speed, while raising the bar for quality so our product stays ahead of the competition. We’re a place for designers who care about doing things well. About the role We're hiring a Senior Product Designer to own design for one of our product areas. You'll join a small team of product designers led by our Director of Product Design, and you'll be embedded in a squad with a product manager and several engineers. Half of our product is used by recipients who never chose us, so the experience has to be self-evident. The other half is a powerful dashboard and API used by everyone from mom-and-pop shops to Google. With one designer per squad, you'll have direct ownership of the experiences you ship. What you'll do Craft rational, elegant, and intuitive interfaces. We care about implementation ease as much as we care about pixel-perfection. Own the content. Designers at Tremendous own the product copy in their designs. Strategic influence. Contribute to the team’s vision, planning, and roadmap. Contribute to our design system. Consistency is a big part of usability, especially for a financial platform. We aim to leave the system better than we found it. Document heavily. We're an async, international team. Your Notion docs and Figma files should give anyone clear context, constraints, and options without a meeting. Use AI throughout your workflow. Research, prototyping, and iteration. We expect designers to prototype with AI tools and bring working artifacts to the team. Help raise the bar. Push forward and maintain a high design bar and level of execution. Design for a diverse set of recipients , with accessibility and internationalization in mind. Collaborative design. Work closely with PMs, Engineers, and others. What you'll bring 8+ years of product design experience. Experience at a startup or fast-moving product company. A portfolio demonstrating functional, simple, and delightful user interfaces. Proven experience building and improving design systems. Excellent written communication and copywriting skills. Experience using AI tools in your design workflow, including prototyping (v0, Claude, Cursor, or similar). The ability to handle ambiguity. You're comfortable conducting research and gathering information to make informed decisions on your own. What's cool about the role Ship work you’ll be proud of. Own design for a product area, end-to-end. You'll help scope, drive, and measure your work, pushing forward user and business goals. Become the champion for your users. You'll conduct research and usability tests to gain a deep understanding of problems before designing solutions. Competitive pay and equity. Base salary for this role: $200,000 - $265,000 Real benefits. 100% covered health (US), unlimited PTO, 12-16 weeks paid parental leave. Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas. Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook .

items.description: Liftoff is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand. Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence. About the role: We're looking for a Finance Manager to join our Commercial FP&A team within Strategic Finance. This team member will own a diverse set of recurring deliverables and analyses that keep the business informed. The Commercial FP&A team acts as the analytical engine of the company, providing insights that support optimal business decision-making. This role requires strong commercial finance acumen and a genuine interest in understanding the "why" behind the numbers. You'll support the narrative behind revenue performance for the Senior Leadership Team and Board-level materials, partner with Commercial and Sales Operations teams on GTM reporting, and help maintain the reporting infrastructure that leadership relies on for in-quarter decisions. Responsibilities: Own recurring revenue reporting workflows - daily/weekly file maintenance, revenue trackers, attainment dashboards, and variance analysis - ensuring accuracy and timely delivery at a daily cadence Prepare and update executive materials for KPI reviews, Board of Directors presentations, and SLT meetings, including slide updates, and supporting data files Conduct variance analysis on revenue movements and deliver clear, concise commentary that explains the "what" and the "why" behind performance trends Support quarterly sales target-setting - assembling bottoms-up data, reconciling against tops-down forecasts, and surfacing risks and opportunities for leadership discussion Own the commercial commission review process - synthesizing attainment data, identifying trends, and providing analysis that informs leadership's compensation and incentive decisions Execute ad-hoc analysis for Revenue, GTM, and Commercial leadership to support in-quarter decision-making Maintain and improve core financial reporting infrastructure - identifying opportunities to enhance accuracy, reduce manual effort, and improve consistency across deliverables Partner cross-functionally with Revenue, Sales Operations, and GTM teams to understand business drivers and translate them into financial context Apply a common-sense quality check to all outputs - flagging anomalies, verifying data integrity, and ensuring deliverables are clean and free of error Exercise independent judgment in prioritizing analyses and sequencing deliverables to maximize impact for commercial leadership Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field with 8+ years of relevant experience, or a Master's degree with 6+ years experience Expert-level Excel and Google Sheets skills - can build, troubleshoot, and maintain complex reporting files independently Strong data analysis capabilities with the ability to work across multiple data sources and reconcile discrepancies Excellent communication skills - can format data clearly for executive audiences and draft concise commentary Experience supporting executive-level reporting (KPI reviews, Board materials, SLT presentations) Ability to ramp quickly on existing processes and deliver reliably with minimal hand-holding Demonstrated ability to thrive in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment Experience in commercial finance / sales finance, preferably in a high-growth or ad tech environment Location: This role is eligible for full-time remote work within British Columbia (Pacific timezone). Travel Expectations: We offer several opportunities for in-person team gatherings, including but not limited to project meetings, regional meetups, and company-wide events. We expect our employees to attend these gatherings at least once per quarter. These gatherings provide essential opportunities for collaboration, communication, and team building. Compensation: Liftoff offers all employees a full compensation package that includes equity and health/vision/dental benefits associated with your country of residence. Below you will find the On Target Earnings (OTE) for our various locations which includes a 10% bonus paid out quarterly. Canada: CAD 125,000 - 150,000 #LI-NM1 #LI-REMOTE Liftoff offers a fast-paced, collaborative, and innovative work environment where employees are empowered to grow and make an impact. We’re shaping the future of the mobile app ecosystem—join us and help accelerate what’s next. Liftoff’s compensation strategy includes competitive salaries, equity, and benefits designed to support employee well-being and performance. We benchmark compensation based on role, level, and location to ensure fairness and market alignment. Benefits may include medical coverage, wellness stipends, and additional perks based on your country of residence. Liftoff is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants regardless of race, ethnicity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Agency and Third Party Recruiter Notice: Liftoff does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third-party recruiting agencies in response to job postings. No fee will be paid to third parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to our hiring managers or Recruiting Team. All candidates must be submitted via our Applicant Tracking System by approved Liftoff vendors who have been expressly requested to make a submission by our Recruiting Team for a specific job opening. No placement fees will be paid to any firm unless such a request has been made by the Liftoff Recruiting Team and such a candidate was submitted to the Liftoff Recruiting Team via our Applicant Tracking System.

Why Mozilla ? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. About this team and role: In the past few years, Marketing has emerged as a key vector and focus of Firefox’s growth, with Data Science playing an essential role in evaluating Marketing’s impact and developing clear strategies to ensure that success. Marketing Data Science supports Firefox through the standard fare of marketing (ongoing measurement, experimentation/lift testing, adhoc analysis, forecasting/budget optimization), and beyond that as thought leaders at Firefox in translating broad goals into clearly defined objectives and identifying the path towards succeeding in them. In this role, you will continue to build on the Marketing team’s recent successes as Firefox’s Marketing program continues to expand its footprint throughout the funnel. You’ll look to support this success in owning global data strategy for Firefox Marketing, developing new data capabilities to unlock future business growth, collaborating with Data Science counterparts in other domains domains, and working closely across marketing and adjacent cross-functional teams to translate your team’s work into practical recommendations and enablement that drive Firefox’s growth. What you’ll do: Set the strategy and roadmap for Marketing Data Science, prioritizing the highest-impact opportunities with key partners. Establish goals and measurement approaches for attribution, ROI, and campaign performance; deliver insights that improve marketing investment and outcomes. Lead and develop the team’s core capabilities across: Performance marketing: budget optimization, causal lift measurement, and conversion-signal testing Brand marketing: measurement planning and assessment of long-term and lower-funnel impact User insights: retention/LTV modeling and audience segmentation Reporting and infrastructure: build self-service dashboards, deliver ad hoc and executive reporting, and develop scalable data models and internal tools that expand our understanding of the acquisition landscape. Bring a forward-looking perspective on advertising, media innovation, and marketing analytics methods. Partner with Data Science leaders to evaluate and responsibly adopt emerging AI tools that improve team workflows and impact. What you’ll bring: 6+ years of marketing data science experience, ideally at a media agency or in-house marketing organization. Proficiency with marketing analytics tools, including Google Analytics and advertising platforms, and familiarity with modeling methods such as MMM, causal lift/synthetic control, saturation modeling, optimization, and Bayesian approaches. Proven experience leading, mentoring, and developing talent, with strong stakeholder management and the ability to prioritize multiple complex workstreams. Strong storytelling and communication skills, with the ability to tailor data-driven insights and recommendations to different audiences. What you’ll get: Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute) Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday One-time home office stipend Annual professional development budget Quarterly well-being stipend Considerable paid parental leave Employee referral bonus program Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country) About Mozilla Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. items.title: Senior Affiliate Marketing Manager
items.summary: At Bondora, our mission is simple: to make finance easy, transparent, and accessible for everyone.
items.description: At Bondora , our mission is simple: to make finance easy, transparent, and accessible for everyone. Founded in 2008, we’ve helped more than 700,000 customers across Europe borrow and invest effortlessly through our trusted digital products. As a rapidly growing financial technology company, we’re reaching new heights with a bold vision. We’re set to acquire a banking license, unlocking a world of possibilities for our customers. This transition will allow us to expand our lending across more EU countries and broaden our product suite to deliver even more value. Join us on this journey and let’s build the future of finance together! What is this role about? 🚀 As a Senior Affiliate Marketing Manager at Bondora , you'll take ownership of the affiliate marketing channel for Go & Grow, managing and growing the partnerships that bring new investors to the platform. You'll work with content creators, publishers, comparison sites, communities, and affiliate networks across Europe, while building a strong pipeline of new partners. This is a highly autonomous, hands-on role where you'll combine partner management with business development — strengthening existing relationships, sourcing and onboarding new affiliates, negotiating commercial agreements, and using data and AI to continuously improve partner performance. You'll work closely with Product, Data, Engineering, Brand, CRM, Legal, and Compliance to optimise the full journey from first click to long-term investor value. You'll have the opportunity to own and shape one of Go & Grow's key growth channels , with direct access to senior leadership and significant freedom to improve how the affiliate programme operates and scales. Your main responsibilities 🎯 Own and Execute the affiliate marketing channel strategy, operating plan, forecast and performance. Source, qualify and close direct partnerships with affiliates (in other words publishers: content creators, comparison sites, communities and relevant affiliate networks). Create clear segmentation, outreach, onboarding and activation routines that move partners from prospect to live Design and negotiate CPA, CPL, fixed-fee and hybrid deals Define and improve the funnel from click and sign-up through funded investor, first 30-day deposits, repeat deposits and 30/60/90-day retained value. Operate and improve Target Circle/Circlewise Build partner- and cohort-level reporting covering acquisition cost, revenue (deposits) value, retention, net revenue (net deposits) Test placements, content, landing pages, incentives, creative and localized messaging with Brand, CRM, Product and Design. Apply country-specific financial-promotion rules, execute approval workflows, required disclosures, content monitoring and documentation together with Legal and Compliance. What would ensure success in this role?💪 Expert in at least one partner management platform (Affiliate platforms such as Target Circle/Circlewise, Impact, Awin or Partnerize, CJ Advanced Excel or Google Sheets and BI dashboard experience AI fluency: Comfortable using AI tools for data analysis, partner research and qualification, and content/compliance review, with strong judgment on when human verification is essential. Fluent in English and German is a plus What can you expect at Bondora ? 🎯 Be part of Bondora ’s ambitious journey toward 1BN in revenue - your work will have a real impact. 💰 Enjoy a competitive salary and amazing benefits: 5 weeks of vacation, private healthcare compensation, hobby grant, mental health support, share options, and much more! 📈 Work in an environment that encourages growth and innovation - with resources and budget for continuous learning. The next steps If you have the guts, ideas, and a team vision, apply now! Our hiring process: 1️⃣ Meet Anna , our Recruiter — your first chat to share your story and ambitions. 2️⃣ Meet Krzysztof Schmidt , CMO at Go&Grow 3️⃣ Tackle a home task to showcase your skills. 4️⃣ Complete our personality and logic assessments via Alva Labs. 5️⃣ Meeting Pärtel Tomberg , CEO of Bondora 6️⃣ Chat with Olga Kikas , our Chief of People 7️⃣ 🎉 If the stars align — welcome to Bondora ! items.title: Product Designer
items.summary: Shape the Future on AutopilotAt Autopilot, you won’t just design screens – you’ll design how fintech works.
items.description: Shape the Future on Autopilot At Autopilot , you won’t just design screens – you’ll design how fintech works. As a Product Designer , you’ll own product experiences end-to-end and help redefine what great UX means in a complex, data-driven industry. We’re building a high-performance, AI-native Fintech Operating System designed to optimize cost and revenue for digital businesses. Join us on a multi-year mission to build smarter infrastructure for commerce. Why Join Us? You’ll help build an ambitious product from the ground up, with a team that values speed, craft, and autonomy. If you’re ready to make an outsized impact in fintech, we’d love to meet you. About the Role You'll join a fast-moving team building modern, data-intensive web applications that help digital businesses operate more intelligently. This is a founding design role with strong emphasis on product logic, systems thinking, and end-to-end collaboration with engineers. 🛠️ What You'll Do Translate complex financial logic and backend systems into intuitive user flows Design dashboards, workflows, and visual systems for payments, orchestration, and automation Build and maintain our scalable design system in Figma (aligned with React components) Collaborate with engineers on real-world UX states — success, failure, pending, retry Prototype and validate features with real data and user context Participate in product discussions, shaping user journeys before pixels are drawn Uphold usability and domain accuracy as the standard for design quality 🎯 What We're Looking For 5+ years of experience designing digital products with complex logic (fintech, B2B SaaS, or data-heavy systems preferred) Strong product and systems thinking — you design for states and workflows , not just screens Deep Figma expertise (Auto Layout, Variants, Tokens, Components) Ability to translate backend logic, APIs, and data models into coherent user experiences Excellent communication and documentation skills (Linear, Figma, Slack) Comfortable working directly with engineers and iterating quickly without handoffs 🌟 Bonus Points Experience in fintech, payments, or compliance-related products Exposure to analytics or developer tooling Understanding of design-to-code workflows (React component parity, tokens) Strong interaction or motion design craft (Framer, ProtoPie, etc.) Our Hiring Process We focus on real-world collaboration, not design showreels. Here’s what to expect: Apply with LinkedIn Profile And Resume We’ll review based on the requirements above. If shortlisted, you’ll receive an email to schedule a 90-minute live design collaboration session once you’re comfortable with our pre-interview brief. 90-Minute Live Design Collaboration You’ll work with our product and engineering team on a small feature challenge — from user problem to Figma prototype. We’ll look at: How you think through logic and flows How you translate constraints into UX decisions Your interaction, hierarchy, and state management How you communicate trade-offs and rationale The session mirrors our actual workflow: accessible pragmatic collaborative Design Review & Feedback After the session, we’ll walk through your design decisions together. You’ll get feedback from our CTO and team, and discuss potential improvements or extensions to your solution. Culture & Alignment Chat A final call with CEO to discuss your long-term goals, how you work best, and whether Autopilot is the right fit for both sides. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.summary: ABOUT RENEW CAPITALRenew Capital is a pan-Africa investment firm with a presence in 13 countries.
items.description: ABOUT RENEW CAPITAL Renew Capital is a pan-Africa investment firm with a presence in 13 countries. We back the bold founders using technology to pursue Africa’s greatest opportunities. With more than a decade of investing on the continent, Renew Capital is among the most active investors building Africa’s thriving private sector. Renew Capital is powered by a team of investment, finance, legal, advisory and market development professionals. Our bench includes seasoned investors, analysts, operators and ecosystem experts with deep experience scaling businesses across Africa. ROLE SUMMARY The sr. financial analyst plays a critical role in evaluating, supporting and scaling high-potential ventures across Africa. This role sits at the core of Renew Capital ’s investment process, supporting sourcing, due diligence, investment decision-making and portfolio value creation. The sr. financial analyst will work closely with investment managers, portfolio company CFOs and senior leadership, building rigorous financial models and translating complex data into clear insights that inform investment decisions. Responsibilities: The sr. financial analyst’s responsibilities are focused on three core areas: 1. Investment Analysis & Due Diligence Prepare and maintain robust financial models for pipeline and prospective investment opportunities. Analyze historical financial data, forecasts and assumptions to assess risk, return, and scalability. Evaluate capital expenditures, depreciation schedules, and capital structuring scenarios. Conduct market sizing, competitive analysis and primary and secondary research to support investment theses. Support financial and commercial due diligence processes from initial screening through investment committee review. 2. Portfolio Support & Monitoring Work directly with portfolio company finance teams on budgeting, 13-week rolling cash flow forecasts, and financial controls. Monitor portfolio company performance, identify trends, calculate key ratios, and flag risks or opportunities early. Build and maintain strong working relationships with portfolio CFOs and founders. 3. Communication & Insight Generation Translate complex analysis into clear, decision-ready materials for investment managers, leadership and the investment committee. Prepare presentations, memos and dashboards that communicate insights concisely. Collaborate with a diverse, distributed investment team across Africa using digital tools. QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business or a related field; MBA or Master’s in Finance preferred. 6–8+ years of progressive experience in financial analysis, investment analysis, private equity, venture capital, investment banking or corporate finance, with exposure to growth-stage companies. Advanced financial modeling expertise, including integrated three-statement models, valuation, scenario and sensitivity analysis and capital structuring. Strong experience supporting or leading financial and commercial due diligence processes. Proven ability to translate complex financial analysis into clear, decision-ready insights for senior leadership and investment committees. Excellent Excel and financial analysis skills, with experience working with large, complex data sets. Strong written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to work effectively with investment teams, portfolio company CFOs and founders across diverse markets. CFA or other recognized investment or financial modeling credentials preferred. WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS As Renew Capital continues to expand its investment activity across Africa, strong financial analysis is essential to deploying capital responsibly and supporting portfolio companies through growth and complexity. This role provides exposure to venture investing across multiple sectors and markets, with the opportunity to influence real investment outcomes. Location and Travel Opportunities: This is a remote role; however, candidates must be based in Côte d'Ivoire. About Renew Capital : We invite you to learn more about Renew Capital by visiting our website:. Application Process: Renew Capital invites qualified applicants to fill out the application form on our website here. Renew Capital is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran or disability status, or any other basis prohibited by law.
